title_zh: 晋公子重耳流亡至齐国，齐桓公厚待之
title_en: Jin prince Chong'er goes into exile in Qi; Duke Huan of Qi treats him generously

title_zh: 晋公子重耳在秦穆公支持下回国即位，是为晋文公
title_en: Jin prince Chong'er returns to Jin with the support of Duke Mu of Qin and ascends the throne as Duke Wen of Jin

title_zh: 晋文公平定王子带之乱，迎周襄王复位
title_en: Duke Wen of Jin puts down Prince Dai's rebellion and restores King Xiang of Zhou

title_zh: 希腊殖民者在黑海西岸建立伊斯特里亚城
title_en: Greek colonists found Istria on the west coast of the Black Sea

title_zh: 楚成王派兵伐宋，宋国求救于晋，晋文公准备救宋
title_en: King Cheng of Chu attacks Song; Song asks for help from Jin; Duke Wen of Jin prepares to rescue Song

title_zh: 晋楚城濮之战前奏：晋军伐曹卫，楚军不得不北移
title_en: Prelude to the Battle of Chengpu: Jin attacks Cao and Wei; Chu army is forced north

title_zh: 晋楚城濮之战，晋文公退避三舍，大败楚军，践土之盟确立晋国霸权
title_en: Battle of Chengpu: Duke Wen of Jin retreats 90 li (three 'she'), then crushes the Chu army; the Treaty of Jiantu establishes Jin's hegemony

title_zh: 希腊殖民者建立昔兰尼（库雷涅）
title_en: Greek colonists found Cyrene

title_zh: 亚述王亚述巴尼拔去世，亚述帝国迅速衰落
title_en: Assyrian king Ashurbanipal dies; the Assyrian Empire rapidly declines

title_zh: 希腊诗人萨福出生（约）
title_en: Birth of the Greek Poet Sappho (circa)

title_zh: 斯巴达镇压美塞尼亚人起义，将美塞尼亚人变为希洛特
title_en: Sparta suppresses the Messenian revolt, reducing the Messenians to helots

title_zh: 秦晋关系破裂，秦国开始谋划东进
title_en: Jin-Qin relations break down; Qin begins to plan eastward expansion

title_zh: 晋文公去世，子晋襄公欢即位
title_en: Duke Wen of Jin dies; his son Huan ascends as Duke Xiang of Jin

title_zh: 秦晋崤之战，晋军全歼秦军，秦东进步伐受挫
title_en: Battle of Xiao between Qin and Jin: Jin forces annihilate the Qin army, thwarting Qin's eastward advance

title_zh: 库普塞洛斯去世，其子佩里安德继任科林斯僭主
title_en: Cypselus dies; his son Periander succeeds as tyrant of Corinth

title_zh: 那波帕拉萨尔建立新巴比伦帝国，正式称王
title_en: Nabopolassar establishes the Neo-Babylonian Empire and formally declares himself king

title_zh: 米底王基亚克萨雷斯进行军事改革，组建骑兵与步兵协同军队
title_en: Median king Cyaxares implements military reforms, creating a combined army of cavalry and infantry

title_zh: 雅典贵族德拉古被任命为立法者，制定严刑峻法
title_en: Athenian aristocrat Draco is appointed lawgiver and issues harsh laws

title_zh: 秦穆公伐晋，渡黄河后焚烧船只以示死战，攻克王官
title_en: Duke Mu of Qin attacks Jin, burns his boats after crossing the Yellow River to show determination, and captures Wangguan

title_zh: 秦穆公征服西戎十二国，称霸西戎，周王赐金鼓
title_en: Duke Mu of Qin conquers twelve Rong states in the west, becoming hegemon of the west; the Zhou king sends him a golden drum

title_zh: 古希腊哲学家泰勒斯出生于米利都
title_en: Ancient Greek philosopher Thales is born in Miletus

title_zh: 雅典颁布德拉古法典，成为首部成文法
title_en: Athens promulgates the Draconian code, the first written law

title_zh: 秦穆公去世，殉葬177人，包括贤臣子车氏三良
title_en: Duke Mu of Qin dies with 177 human sacrifices, including three worthy ministers of the Zi-che family

title_zh: 晋赵盾专政，开始赵氏崛起
title_en: Zhao Dun of Jin takes power, marking the rise of the Zhao clan

title_zh: 周襄王去世，子周顷王壬臣即位
title_en: King Xiang of Zhou dies; his son King Qing of Zhou, Ji Renchen, ascends

title_zh: 楚穆王伐郑，郑穆公求和，楚国势力深入中原
title_en: King Mu of Chu attacks Zheng; Duke Mu of Zheng makes peace, extending Chu influence deep into the Central Plains

title_zh: 楚穆王与蔡庄公、陈共公、郑穆公盟于厥貉，楚称霸中原
title_en: King Mu of Chu meets with the rulers of Cai, Chen, and Zheng at Jueyi, establishing Chu's hegemony over the Central Plains

title_zh: 伊特鲁里亚人卢库摩篡位成为罗马国王，改名塔奎尼乌斯·普里斯库斯
title_en: Etruscan Lucumo seizes power in Rome and becomes king, taking the name Tarquinius Priscus

title_zh: 燕襄公迁都蓟城，加强华北统治
title_en: Duke Xiang of Yan moves the capital to Ji City, strengthening control over northern China

title_zh: 米底军队攻陷亚述古城阿拉普哈，亚述残部退守哈兰
title_en: Median army captures the Assyrian ancient city of Arapkha; Assyrian remnants retreat to Harran

title_zh: 楚庄王即位，三年不鸣，一鸣惊人
title_en: King Zhuang of Chu ascends the throne; after three years of silence, he startles all

title_zh: 亚述帝国彻底瓦解，尼尼微被米底和新巴比伦联军围困
title_en: The Assyrian Empire completely collapses; Nineveh is besieged by the Medes and Neo-Babylonians

title_zh: 晋国赵盾联合诸侯攻郑，因郑背晋附楚
title_en: Zhao Dun of Jin leads a coalition to attack Zheng because Zheng abandoned Jin for Chu

title_zh: 埃及法老尼科二世驱逐巴比伦驻军，侵入巴勒斯坦
title_en: Egyptian pharaoh Necho II expels Babylonian garrisons and invades Palestine

title_zh: 希腊自然哲学在米利都学派中萌芽
title_en: Natural philosophy emerges in the Milesian school

title_zh: 埃及法老尼科二世在美吉多击败犹大王约西亚，约西亚战死
title_en: Egyptian pharaoh Necho II defeats and kills King Josiah of Judah at Megiddo

title_zh: 齐国伐莒，莒国求和，齐国势力东扩
title_en: Qi attacks Ju; Ju sues for peace; Qi expands eastward

title_zh: 晋赵盾族弟赵穿弑晋灵公，赵盾返晋立成公，史书书“赵盾弑其君”
title_en: Zhao Chuan, cousin of Zhao Dun of Jin, assassinates Duke Ling of Jin; Zhao Dun returns and establishes Duke Cheng; the historian records 'Zhao Dun assassinated his ruler'

title_zh: 楚庄王北上问鼎中原，楚国霸业初成
title_en: King Zhuang of Chu marches north to inquire about the Nine Tripods, establishing Chu's hegemony

title_zh: 巴比伦王那波帕拉萨尔去世，尼布甲尼撒二世即位，卡尔基米什战役大胜埃及
title_en: Babylonian king Nabopolassar dies; Nebuchadnezzar II ascends and crushes Egypt at the Battle of Carchemish

title_zh: 尼布甲尼撒二世正式成为巴比伦王，开始大规模建筑计划
title_en: Nebuchadnezzar II formally becomes king of Babylon; begins massive building projects

title_zh: 楚庄王伐陈，杀夏征舒，初欲灭陈，后复封陈，得诸侯称赞
title_en: King Zhuang of Chu attacks Chen, executes Xia Zhengshu, initially intends to annex Chen but later restores it, winning praise from the feudal lords

title_zh: 黄河在杞县改道，造成重大水患，诸侯共修堤防
title_en: The Yellow River changes course at Qi County, causing major flooding; vassal states jointly build dikes

title_zh: 希腊抒情诗人萨福在莱斯博斯岛活跃，创作爱情诗
title_en: Greek lyric poet Sappho flourishes on Lesbos, composing love poetry

title_zh: 楚庄王大败晋军于邲，楚国确立霸主地位
title_en: King Zhuang of Chu defeats Jin at the Battle of Bi, establishing Chu's hegemony

title_zh: 苏斯鲁塔撰成《妙闻集》
title_en: Sushruta compiles the Sushruta Samhita

title_zh: 伯牙《高山流水》
title_en: High Mountains Flowing Water

title_zh: 腓尼基人环航非洲
title_en: Phoenicians circumnavigate Africa

title_zh: 孔子编订《诗经》
title_en: Confucius compiles the Book of Songs

title_zh: 孙叔敖修芍陂
title_en: Sunshu Ao builds Shaopi

title_zh: 腓尼基船队完成非洲环绕航行
title_en: Phoenician fleet completes circumnavigation of Africa

title_zh: 米利都学派哲学家阿那克西曼德提出“无限定”本原说
title_en: Milesian philosopher Anaximander proposes the 'apeiron' as the arche

title_zh: 犹大国王约雅斤即位，面临巴比伦威胁
title_en: Jehoiachin becomes king of Judah, facing Babylonian threat

title_zh: 邲之战：楚国大败晋国，确立中原霸权
title_en: Battle of Bi: Chu defeats Jin, securing hegemony over the Central Plains

title_zh: 巴比伦攻陷耶路撒冷，掳走约雅斤
title_en: Babylon captures Jerusalem, exiles Jehoiachin

title_zh: 古希腊奥林匹克竞技会增设少年项目
title_en: Ancient Greek Olympic Games add events for boys

title_zh: 楚庄王长期围困宋都，迫使宋国臣服
title_en: King Zhuang of Chu lays prolonged siege to Song, forcing its submission

title_zh: 雅典梭伦改革，奠定民主政治基础
title_en: Solon's reforms in Athens lay foundation for democracy

title_zh: 梭伦立法改革雅典
title_en: Solon reforms Athenian law

title_zh: 楚庄王令尹孙叔敖主持水利工程
title_en: Chu Prime Minister Sun Shu'ao oversees water conservancy project

title_zh: 晋国中军将郤克使齐受辱，埋下两国战争伏笔
title_en: Jin minister Xi Ke humiliated on mission to Qi, sowing seeds for war

title_zh: 一代霸主楚庄王去世，楚国霸业动摇
title_en: Death of the great hegemon King Zhuang of Chu; Chu's hegemony falters

title_zh: 晋国与卫国、郑国结盟以对抗楚国
title_en: Jin forms alliance with Wei and Zheng to counter Chu

title_zh: 巴比伦空中花园处于鼎盛时期
title_en: Hanging Gardens of Babylon at their zenith

title_zh: 鞌之战：晋国大败齐国，齐国求和
title_en: Battle of An: Jin defeats Qi, Qi sues for peace

title_zh: 希腊人开始铸造银币，推动商业革命
title_en: Greeks begin minting silver coins, spurring a commercial revolution

title_zh: 西底家反叛巴比伦，耶路撒冷再遭围困
title_en: Zedekiah rebels against Babylon; Jerusalem besieged again

title_zh: 巴比伦攻陷耶路撒冷，犹大王国灭亡
title_en: Babylon captures Jerusalem, ending the Kingdom of Judah

title_zh: 老子担任周朝守藏室之史
title_en: Laozi serves as keeper of the Zhou royal archives

title_zh: 泰勒斯准确预言日全食，终止两国战争
title_en: Thales accurately predicts a solar eclipse, halting a war

title_zh: 晋国迁都新田，史称“新绛”
title_en: Jin moves its capital to Xintian, known as 'New Jiang'

title_zh: 晋景公诛杀赵氏一族，制造“下宫之难”
title_en: Duke Jing of Jin orders massacre of the Zhao clan, the 'Disaster of the Lower Palace'

title_zh: 德尔斐皮提亚竞技会正式创立
title_en: Pythian Games officially founded at Delphi

title_zh: 楚共王与秦结盟，对抗晋国
title_en: King Gong of Chu allies with Qin against Jin

title_zh: 晋、秦两国君主在令狐会盟
title_en: Rulers of Jin and Qin meet at Linghu

title_zh: 第一次弭兵之会，晋楚短暂休战
title_en: First Disarmament Conference: Jin and Chu briefly cease hostilities

title_zh: 晋厉公大败秦军于麻隧
title_en: Duke Li of Jin defeats Qin at Masui

title_zh: 塞尔维乌斯·图利乌斯成为罗马王，推行改革
title_en: Servius Tullius becomes king of Rome, initiates reforms

title_zh: 郑国背楚附晋，引发南部动荡
title_en: Zheng defects from Chu to Jin, causing southern turmoil

title_zh: 古希腊哲学家阿那克西米尼提出“气”是万物本原
title_en: Greek philosopher Anaximenes proposes 'air' as the arche

title_zh: 鄢陵之战：晋国击败楚国，重夺霸主地位
title_en: Battle of Yanling: Jin defeats Chu, regains hegemony

title_zh: 罗马王国开始修筑塞尔维乌斯城墙
title_en: Construction of the Servian Wall begins in Rome

title_zh: 晋国为强化集权，逐步收回卿大夫封邑
title_en: Jin begins reclaiming ministerial fiefs to strengthen central authority

title_zh: 晋厉公被弑，晋悼公即位
title_en: Duke Li of Jin assassinated; Duke Dao ascends the throne

title_zh: 摩揭陀国王频毗娑罗开始征服周边小国
title_en: King Bimbisara of Magadha begins conquering neighboring states

title_zh: 晋悼公推行新政，中兴晋国霸业
title_en: Duke Dao of Jin implements new policies, reviving Jin's hegemony

title_zh: 周灵王即位，王室更为衰微
title_en: King Ling of Zhou ascends throne; royal house further weakened

title_zh: 雅典城市酒神节正式确立，西方戏剧由此诞生
title_en: City Dionysia festival formalized in Athens; Western drama born

title_zh: 道家学派创始人老子在陈国或苦县著书立说
title_en: Laozi, founder of Daoism, writes and teaches in Chen or Ku County

title_zh: 古希腊数学家毕达哥拉斯出生
title_en: Birth of the ancient Greek mathematician Pythagoras

title_zh: 鲁国颁布“初税亩”，承认土地私有
title_en: Lu enacts 'initial taxation of private fields', recognizing private land ownership

title_zh: 鲁国天文学家系统记录日食与流星雨
title_en: Lu astronomers systematically record solar eclipse and meteor shower

title_zh: 埃及法老阿普里埃斯被推翻
title_en: Egyptian pharaoh Apries overthrown

title_zh: 泛雅典娜节增加体育竞技项目
title_en: Panathenaic Games add athletic competitions

title_zh: 晋悼公在鸡泽大会诸侯，重振晋国声威
title_en: Duke Dao of Jin convenes vassals at Jize, restoring Jin's prestige

title_zh: 楚国与吴国发生边境冲突，吴国开始崛起
title_en: Border conflict between Chu and Wu; Wu begins to rise

title_zh: 佛教创始人释迦牟尼诞生于蓝毗尼园
title_en: Birth of Siddhartha Gautama (Buddha) at Lumbini

title_zh: 新巴比伦国王尼布甲尼撒二世去世，帝国衰落开始
title_en: Death of Nebuchadnezzar II of Neo-Babylon; empire begins to decline

title_zh: 庇西特拉图依靠平民力量在雅典建立僭主统治
title_en: Peisistratus establishes tyranny in Athens with popular support

title_zh: 晋悼公、齐灵公、宋平公等七国在萧鱼会盟
title_en: Duke Dao of Jin meets with seven states at Xiaoyu

title_zh: 吕底亚国王克洛伊索斯即位，推行金本位制
title_en: Croesus becomes king of Lydia, introduces gold coinage

title_zh: 居鲁士二世成为波斯部落首领，开始反抗米底
title_en: Cyrus II becomes leader of Persian tribes, begins to resist Media

title_zh: 晋国中行偃率联军讨伐秦国，深入泾河
title_en: Zhonghang Yan of Jin leads allied forces against Qin, reaching the Jing River

title_zh: 古希腊哲学家色诺芬尼批判传统神人同形说
title_en: Greek philosopher Xenophanes criticizes anthropomorphic gods

title_zh: 吕底亚国王克洛伊索斯征服希腊小亚细亚城邦
title_en: Croesus of Lydia conquers Greek cities in Asia Minor

title_zh: 波斯居鲁士二世秘密联络各地波斯部落，准备起义
title_en: Cyrus II secretly contacts Persian tribes, prepares revolt

title_zh: 居鲁士二世公开反叛米底，发动波斯独立战争
title_en: Cyrus II openly rebels against Media, launching Persian War of Independence

title_zh: 波斯军击败米底，阿斯提阿格斯被俘
title_en: Persian army defeats Media; Astyages captured

title_zh: 孔子创立儒家
title_en: Confucius founds Confucianism

title_zh: 儒家学派创始人孔子诞生
title_en: Birth of Confucius, founder of Confucianism

title_zh: 阿契美尼德波斯建立
title_en: Achaemenid Persia founded

title_zh: 米利都的赫卡泰奥斯绘制世界地图
title_en: Hecataeus of Miletus draws a world map

title_zh: 居鲁士二世定都帕萨尔加德，建立波斯帝国
title_en: Cyrus II establishes capital at Pasargadae, founding the Persian Empire

title_zh: 波斯居鲁士二世征服帕提亚和希尔卡尼亚
title_en: Cyrus II conquers Parthia and Hyrcania

title_zh: 古希腊米利都学派哲学家阿那克西米尼去世
title_en: Death of Anaximenes, the Milesian philosopher

title_zh: 居鲁士二世征服吕底亚，俘虏国王克洛伊索斯
title_en: Cyrus II conquers Lydia, captures King Croesus

title_zh: 第二次弭兵之会：晋楚平分霸权，开启和平时期
title_en: Second Disarmament Conference: Jin and Chu share hegemony, ushering in peace

title_zh: 波斯征服小亚细亚希腊城邦，引发文化碰撞
title_en: Persia conquers Greek city-states in Asia Minor, sparking cultural contact

title_zh: 周灵王去世，周景王即位
title_en: Death of King Ling of Zhou; King Jing ascends throne

title_zh: 吴王馀祭被越国俘虏刺杀，吴越交恶升级
title_en: King Yu Ji of Wu assassinated by a Yue captive; Wu-Yue enmity deepens

title_zh: 子产在郑国执政，开启系列改革
title_en: Zichan takes power in Zheng, initiates reforms

title_zh: 波斯居鲁士二世征服中亚地区，抵达药杀水
title_en: Cyrus II conquers Central Asia, reaches the Jaxartes

title_zh: 秦国在新征服区普遍推行县制
title_en: Qin widely adopts the district (xian) system in newly conquered areas

title_zh: 斯巴达建立伯罗奔尼撒同盟，称霸南希腊
title_en: Sparta establishes the Peloponnesian League, dominating southern Greece

title_zh: 居鲁士入巴比伦
title_en: Cyrus enters Babylon

title_zh: 居鲁士大帝征服巴比伦，末代国王伯沙撒被杀
title_en: Cyrus the Great conquers Babylon; last king Belshazzar killed

title_zh: 居鲁士发布诏令，释放犹太人回归故土
title_en: Cyrus issues edict allowing Jews to return to their homeland

title_zh: 第一批犹太人启程返回耶路撒冷
title_en: First group of Jews departs for Jerusalem

title_zh: 居鲁士释放巴比伦囚虏
title_en: Cyrus frees Babylonian exiles

title_zh: 波斯征服印度河流域，帝国疆域达到最大
title_en: Persia conquers the Indus Valley, reaching its greatest territorial extent

title_zh: 希腊哲学家赫拉克利特出生
title_en: Birth of the Greek philosopher Heraclitus

title_zh: 子产在郑国“铸刑书”，公布成文法
title_en: Zichan of Zheng 'casts the penal code', publishing written law

title_zh: 泰斯庇斯在雅典首次扮演角色，被誉为“第一位演员”
title_en: Thespis plays a role in Athens, hailed as the 'first actor'

title_zh: 罗马国王塞尔维乌斯·图利乌斯被女儿谋杀，塔奎尼乌斯篡位
title_en: King Servius Tullius murdered by his daughter; Tarquinius seizes throne

title_zh: 波斯帝国建立完善的驿站和御道系统
title_en: Persian Empire builds an extensive courier and Royal Road system

title_zh: 释迦牟尼出家修行，寻求解脱之路
title_en: Siddhartha Gautama renounces worldly life in search of liberation

title_zh: 孔子开始从事“儒”的职业，学习礼乐文化
title_en: Confucius begins work as a 'ru' (ritual master), studying rites and music

title_zh: 居鲁士大帝在中亚征战时阵亡，冈比西斯二世继位
title_en: Cyrus the Great dies in battle in Central Asia; Cambyses II succeeds

title_zh: 冈比西斯二世巩固统治，准备远征埃及
title_en: Cambyses II consolidates power and prepares to invade Egypt

title_zh: 释迦牟尼在菩提伽耶悟道成佛
title_en: Siddhartha attains enlightenment under the Bodhi tree

title_zh: 释迦牟尼成道
title_en: Siddhartha Gautama attains enlightenment

title_zh: 雅典僭主庇西特拉图去世，其子继位
title_en: Death of Peisistratus; his sons succeed as tyrants of Athens

title_zh: 埃及法老雅赫摩斯二世去世，普萨美提克三世继位

title_zh: 叙利亚少年埃拉伽巴路斯被其祖母拥立为罗马皇帝
title_en: Syrian teenager Elagabalus proclaimed Roman emperor by his grandmother

title_zh: 蔡伦改进的造纸术在东汉黄河流域推广普及
title_en: Cai Lun's improved papermaking technology spreads in the Yellow River region of Eastern Han

title_zh: 曹操攻灭袁谭，平定冀州全境
title_en: Cao Cao attacks and destroys Yuan Tan, pacifying the whole of Jizhou

title_zh: 曹操颁布《收田租令》，实行定额田租制
title_en: Cao Cao issues the 'Edict on Grain Collection', implementing a fixed land tax

title_zh: 罗马皇帝塞维鲁在帕拉丁山扩建皇宫，建造塞维鲁凯旋门
title_en: Roman emperor Severus expands palace on Palatine Hill, builds Arch of Severus

title_zh: 曹操攻灭并州刺史高干，完全控制黄河以北
title_en: Cao Cao attacks and destroys Gao Gan, governor of Bingzhou, securing full control north of the Yellow River

title_zh: 诸葛亮在隆中对中提出三分天下战略，出山辅佐刘备
title_en: Zhuge Liang presents the Longzhong Plan and joins Liu Bei as his advisor

title_zh: 曹操白狼山一战大破乌桓骑兵，统一中国北方
title_en: Cao Cao crushes the Wuhuan cavalry at White Wolf Mountain, unifying northern China

title_zh: 罗马帝国非洲行省成为帝国粮仓，向罗马输送大量谷物
title_en: Roman Africa Province becomes the empire's breadbasket, shipping huge amounts of grain to Rome

title_zh: 曹操北征乌桓途中登碣石山作《观沧海》
title_en: Cao Cao climbs Mount Jieshi and composes 'View of the Blue Sea' while on campaign against the Wuhuan

title_zh: 曹操占领荆州，刘琮投降
title_en: Cao Cao seizes Jingzhou; Liu Cong surrenders

title_zh: 日耳曼部落因气候变化压力开始结成联盟，频繁侵扰罗马边境
title_en: Germanic tribes begin forming confederations due to climate change, frequently raid Roman borders

title_zh: 孙刘联军在赤壁用火攻大败曹操，奠定三国鼎立格局
title_en: Sun–Liu allied forces defeat Cao Cao at Red Cliffs using fire attack, establishing the Three Kingdoms pattern

title_zh: 刘备派诸葛亮出使江东，促成孙刘联盟抗曹
title_en: Liu Bei sends Zhuge Liang to Jiangdong to negotiate the Sun–Liu alliance against Cao Cao

title_zh: 孙权将其妹嫁给刘备以巩固孙刘联盟
title_en: Sun Quan gives his younger sister in marriage to Liu Bei to solidify the Sun–Liu alliance

title_zh: 罗马皇帝塞维鲁病逝前叮嘱二子“搞好军队，其余皆可忽视”
title_en: Roman emperor Severus, on his deathbed, tells his sons: 'Enrich the soldiers; nothing else matters'

title_zh: 周瑜、程普与曹仁争夺江陵，孙权、刘备乘机拓展地盘
title_en: Zhou Yu and Cheng Pu fight Cao Ren for Jiangling; Sun Quan and Liu Bei expand their territory

title_zh: 曹操颁布《求贤令》，强调“唯才是举”
title_en: Cao Cao issues a 'Call for Talent', emphasizing 'employment based solely on ability'

title_zh: 东吴名将周瑜在巴丘病逝，时年36岁
title_en: Eastern Wu general Zhou Yu dies of illness at Baqiu, aged 36

title_zh: 罗马皇帝卡拉卡拉为巩固权力杀死其弟盖塔
title_en: Roman emperor Caracalla kills his brother Geta to consolidate power

title_zh: 曹操西征关中，在渭南之战中击败马超、韩遂联军
title_en: Cao Cao campaigns west, defeats Ma Chao and Han Sui at the Battle of Weinan

title_zh: 刘备应刘璋之邀率军入蜀，驻守葭萌关
title_en: At Liu Zhang's invitation, Liu Bei leads his army into Shu and stations at Jiameng Pass

title_zh: 卡拉卡拉把罗马公民权授予帝国自由民
title_en: Caracalla grants Roman citizenship to the empire's free inhabitants

title_zh: 曹操首席谋士荀彧因反对曹操进爵国公而自杀
title_en: Cao Cao's chief strategist Xun Yu commits suicide for opposing Cao Cao's elevation to duke

title_zh: 孙权迁都秣陵并修筑石头城，改名建业
title_en: Sun Quan moves his capital to Moling and builds Stone City, renaming it Jianye

title_zh: 刘备与刘璋正式决裂，刘备攻取涪城
title_en: Liu Bei breaks with Liu Zhang and captures Fucheng

title_zh: 汉献帝册封曹操为魏公，建立魏国，划给十郡封地
title_en: Emperor Xian of Han appoints Cao Cao as Duke of Wei, establishes state of Wei, grants ten commanderies

title_zh: 汉献帝皇后伏氏因谋诛曹操失败，被废黜并处死
title_en: Empress Fu, wife of Emperor Xian of Han, deposed and executed after failed plot against Cao Cao

title_zh: 曹操率军进入陇右，收服杨秋，平定凉州
title_en: Cao Cao leads army into Longyou, subdues Yang Qiu, pacifies Liangzhou

title_zh: 罗马皇帝卡拉卡拉远征日耳曼，沿莱茵河修筑要塞
title_en: Roman emperor Caracalla campaigns against the Germans, builds forts along the Rhine

title_zh: 刘备攻陷成都，领有益州全境
title_en: Liu Bei captures Chengdu and takes full control of Yizhou

title_zh: 曹操率军征讨张鲁，攻占汉中
title_en: Cao Cao campaigns against Zhang Lu and captures Hanzhong

title_zh: 孙权派诸葛瑾与刘备交涉，荆州之争表面缓和
title_en: Sun Quan sends Zhuge Jin to negotiate with Liu Bei; dispute over Jingzhou temporarily eased

title_zh: 卡拉卡拉东征帕提亚，攻掠美索不达米亚
title_en: Caracalla campaigns east against Parthia, plunders Mesopotamia

title_zh: 卡拉卡拉率军入侵帕提亚腹地，烧杀抢掠
title_en: Caracalla invades the heart of Parthia, pillaging and burning

title_zh: 曹操处死名士崔琰，打击士族势力
title_en: Cao Cao executes the famous scholar Cui Yan, suppressing the gentry

title_zh: 汉献帝册封曹操为魏王，位在诸侯王之上
title_en: Emperor Xian of Han appoints Cao Cao as King of Wei, ranking above all feudal kings

title_zh: 坎尼会战
title_en: Battle of Cannae

title_zh: 马克西米努斯·色雷克斯被军队拥立为罗马皇帝
title_en: Maximinus Thrax proclaimed Roman emperor by the army

title_zh: 曹操与刘备在汉中激战，双方相持不下
title_en: Cao Cao and Liu Bei fight fiercely in Hanzhong; both sides reach a stalemate

title_zh: 建安大瘟疫席卷中原，建安七子中多人病逝
title_en: Great plague ravages Central China; several of the 'Seven Scholars of Jian'an' die

title_zh: 罗马皇帝亚历山大·塞维鲁被士兵杀害，三世纪危机加剧
title_en: Roman emperor Severus Alexander killed by soldiers, escalating the Crisis of the Third Century

title_zh: 罗马皇帝卡拉卡拉在卡莱附近遇刺身亡
title_en: Roman emperor Caracalla assassinated near Carrhae

title_zh: 第二次布匿战争
title_en: Second Punic War

title_zh: 刘备与曹操激战于定军山、汉水，争夺汉中进入白热化
title_en: Liu Bei and Cao Cao fight fiercely at Mount Dingjun and the Han River; the contest for Hanzhong intensifies

title_zh: 叙利亚少年埃拉伽巴路斯被拥立为帝，与马克里努斯争位
title_en: Syrian teenager Elagabalus proclaimed emperor in opposition to Macrinus

title_zh: 罗马皇帝埃拉伽巴路斯强迫元老院接受叙利亚太阳神崇拜，引发文化冲突
title_en: Roman emperor Elagabalus forces the Senate to accept the Syrian sun god, causing cultural conflict

title_zh: 关羽发动襄樊战役，水淹七军，威震华夏
title_en: Guan Yu launches the Fancheng campaign, floods seven armies, terrifies the Central Plains

title_zh: 吕蒙白衣渡江偷袭江陵，关羽败走麦城被杀
title_en: Lü Meng captures Jiangling in a 'white‑sailed boat' ruse; Guan Yu flees to Maicheng and is killed

title_zh: 刘备在沔阳自称汉中王，建立汉中王府
title_en: Liu Bei proclaims himself King of Hanzhong at Mianyang and establishes the Hanzhong King's office

title_zh: 曹操病逝于洛阳，临终遗令薄葬
title_en: Cao Cao dies of illness in Luoyang, leaving instructions for a simple burial

title_zh: 曹丕采纳陈群建议，正式设立九品中正制
title_en: Cao Pi adopts Chen Qun's proposal and formally institutes the nine‑rank system for official recruitment

title_zh: 曹丕代汉建魏，东汉正式灭亡，三国鼎立局面形成
title_en: Cao Pi usurps the Han throne and establishes the Wei dynasty; Eastern Han ends, Three Kingdoms tripartite equilibrium forms

title_zh: 中美洲特奥蒂瓦坎城邦进入繁荣期，太阳金字塔扩建
title_en: Teotihuacan in Mesoamerica enters its flourishing period; Sun Pyramid expanded

title_zh: 哥特人首次大规模越过多瑙河入侵罗马帝国
title_en: Goths launch first large‑scale invasion of the Roman Empire across the Danube

title_zh: 刘备在成都即皇帝位，国号汉，史称蜀汉
title_en: Liu Bei ascends the imperial throne at Chengdu; his dynasty is called Han, known to history as Shu Han

title_zh: 刘备为报关羽之仇，兴兵七万伐吴
title_en: To avenge Guan Yu, Liu Bei mobilizes 70,000 troops to attack Wu

title_zh: 魏文帝曹丕册封孙权为吴王，加九锡，赐荆州牧
title_en: Emperor Wen of Wei (Cao Pi) enfeoffs Sun Quan as King of Wu with the Nine Bestowals and appoints him Governor of Jingzhou

title_zh: 罗马皇帝埃拉伽巴路斯被禁卫军刺杀，其堂弟亚历山大·塞维鲁继位
title_en: Roman emperor Elagabalus assassinated by the Praetorian Guard; his cousin Severus Alexander succeeds

title_zh: 罗马少年皇帝亚历山大·塞维鲁即位，元老院恢复一定权威
title_en: Roman teenage emperor Severus Alexander ascends; Senate regains some authority

title_zh: 孙权接受魏国封号但拒不派质子，称吴王建元黄武
title_en: Sun Quan accepts Wei titles but refuses to send a hostage; proclaims himself King of Wu and adopts reign name Huangwu

title_zh: 刘禅在成都继位，诸葛亮开府治事，与东吴重修盟好
title_en: Liu Shan succeeds in Chengdu; Zhuge Liang opens his office and restores the alliance with Wu

title_zh: 刘备夷陵之战惨败，逃往白帝城，次年病逝
title_en: Liu Bei suffers a crushing defeat at the Battle of Xiaoting; flees to Baidi City, dies the following year

title_zh: 诸葛亮派邓芝出使东吴，修复两国关系
title_en: Zhuge Liang sends Deng Zhi as envoy to Wu to repair bilateral relations

title_zh: 罗马帝国多瑙河防线因哥特人入侵局部崩溃
title_en: Roman Empire's Danube frontier partially collapses due to Gothic invasion

title_zh: 魏文帝曹丕率三路大军伐吴，无功而返
title_en: Emperor Wen of Wei (Cao Pi) launches a three‑pronged invasion of Wu, but fails to achieve his aim

title_zh: 萨珊波斯阿尔达希尔一世推翻安息帝国，建立萨珊王朝
title_en: Ardashir I of Sasanian Persia overthrows the Parthian Empire and founds the Sasanian dynasty

title_zh: 诸葛亮在成都大力发展生产，整饬武备
title_en: Zhuge Liang vigorously develops production and prepares the military in Chengdu

title_zh: 曹丕再次亲征东吴，至广陵无功而返
title_en: Cao Pi again personally leads an expedition against Wu, reaching Guangling but returning without success

title_zh: 曹丕最后一次征吴，至广陵临江观兵而还，不久病逝
title_en: Cao Pi's last campaign against Wu: reviews troops on the Yangtze at Guangling and returns; dies soon after

title_zh: 萨珊波斯阿尔达希尔一世在泰西封正式加冕为“众王之王”
title_en: Ardashir I of Sasanian Persia formally crowned 'King of Kings' at Ctesiphon

title_zh: 诸葛亮南征，七擒孟获，平定南中叛乱
title_en: Zhuge Liang's southern campaign: captures Meng Huo seven times, pacifies the Nanzhong rebellion

title_zh: 萨珊波斯阿尔达希尔一世统一波斯全境，建立中央集权
title_en: Ardashir I of Sasanian Persia unifies all Persia and establishes centralized rule

title_zh: 罗马皇帝亚历山大·塞维鲁亲征波斯，戈迪安三世被加封为凯撒
title_en: Roman emperor Severus Alexander personally campaigns against Persia; Gordian III appointed Caesar

title_zh: 魏文帝曹丕病逝于洛阳，太子曹叡即位
title_en: Emperor Wen of Wei (Cao Pi) dies in Luoyang; Crown Prince Cao Rui succeeds

title_zh: 新城太守孟达叛魏投蜀，司马懿千里奔袭将其擒斩
title_en: Meng Da, governor of Xincheng, rebels against Wei and defects to Shu; Sima Yi marches a thousand li and captures him

title_zh: 萨珊帝国与罗马帝国在美索不达米亚爆发边境冲突
title_en: Border clashes erupt between the Sasanian Empire and the Roman Empire in Mesopotamia

title_zh: 诸葛亮上《出师表》，率军进驻汉中准备北伐
title_en: Zhuge Liang presents the 'Chu Shi Biao', leads his army to Hanzhong to prepare for the northern expedition

title_zh: 东吴陆逊在石亭大破曹休，魏国举国震动
title_en: Eastern Wu's Lu Xun destroys Cao Xiu at Shiting, shocking the entire Wei state

title_zh: 诸葛亮第二次北伐，围攻陈仓不克而还
title_en: Zhuge Liang's second northern expedition: besieges Chencang but fails to take it

title_zh: 诸葛亮第一次北伐，马谡失街亭致全局失败
title_en: Zhuge Liang's first northern expedition: Ma Su loses Jieting, leading to complete failure

title_zh: 孙权在武昌正式称帝，国号吴，改元黄龙
title_en: Sun Quan formally proclaims himself emperor at Wuchang, with the dynasty name Wu, era name Huanglong

title_zh: 诸葛亮第三次北伐，攻取武都、阴平二郡
title_en: Zhuge Liang's third northern expedition: takes Wudu and Yinping commanderies

title_zh: 孙权在称帝后正式迁都建业
title_en: After proclaiming himself emperor, Sun Quan formally moves the capital to Jianye

title_zh: 蜀汉与东吴缔结盟约，正式约定共同伐魏
title_en: Shu Han and Eastern Wu conclude a formal alliance, agreeing to jointly attack Wei

title_zh: 罗马法学家编纂《格列高利法典》，系统整理帝国法令
title_en: Roman jurists compile the 'Codex Gregorianus', systematically organizing imperial edicts

title_zh: 孙权派遣将军卫温、诸葛直率万人船队赴夷洲求仙访俗
title_en: Sun Quan sends generals Wei Wen and Zhuge Zhi with a fleet of 10,000 men to seek the legendary island of Yizhou (Taiwan)

title_zh: 曹魏大司马曹真伐蜀，遇大雨栈道断绝，无功而返
title_en: Cao Wei's Grand Marshal Cao Zhen invades Shu, but heavy rains wash away the plank roads; the campaign ends in failure

title_zh: 魏国名将张郃在木门道追击蜀军时中箭身亡
title_en: Wei general Zhang He is killed by a crossbow bolt while pursuing the Shu army at the Mumen path

title_zh: 诸葛亮第四次北伐，制造木牛运粮，与司马懿对峙
title_en: Zhuge Liang's fourth northern expedition: uses wooden oxen for transport, confronts Sima Yi

title_zh: 罗马皇帝亚历山大·塞维鲁率军反击萨珊波斯，取得一定胜利
title_en: Roman emperor Severus Alexander counterattacks the Sasanian Persians and wins some victories

title_zh: 诸葛亮在汉中休整，改进武器装备，制造连弩和木牛流马
title_en: Zhuge Liang rests and refurbishes in Hanzhong, improving weapons and making repeating crossbows and wooden oxen/flowing horses

title_zh: 陈思王曹植在抑郁中去世，年仅41岁
title_en: Chen Si Wang (Prince of Chen Si) Cao Zhi dies in depression, aged 41

title_zh: 诸葛亮在渭南实行屯田，为第五次北伐积粮
title_en: Zhuge Liang implements military‑agricultural colonies south of the Wei River, storing grain for the fifth northern expedition

title_zh: 罗马皇帝亚历山大·塞维鲁与萨珊签订和约，维持东部和平
title_en: Roman emperor Severus Alexander concludes peace with the Sasanians, maintaining peace in the east

title_zh: 诸葛亮第五次北伐，出斜谷，屯兵五丈原
title_en: Zhuge Liang's fifth northern expedition: exits the Xie Valley, encamps at Wu Zhang Plains

title_zh: 日耳曼部落越过莱茵河，威胁罗马高卢行省
title_en: Germanic tribes cross the Rhine, threatening the Roman province of Gaul

title_zh: 诸葛亮病逝于五丈原军中，享年54岁
title_en: Zhuge Liang dies of illness at the Wu Zhang Plains camp, aged 54

title_zh: 蜀军在退兵后发生魏延与杨仪内讧，魏延被杀
title_en: After the Shu army withdraws, Wei Yan and Yang Yi turn on each other; Wei Yan is killed

title_zh: 三世纪危机：军团、税负与戴克里先的重组
title_en: The third-century crisis: armies, taxes and Diocletian's reorganisation

title_zh: 蒋琬接替诸葛亮执掌蜀汉国政，继承北伐遗志
title_en: Jiang Wan takes charge of Shu Han affairs after Zhuge Liang, continuing the plans for northern expeditions

title_zh: 魏明帝曹叡大兴土木，修建洛阳宫室，造成国力损耗
title_en: Emperor Ming of Wei (Cao Rui) embarks on lavish construction of Luoyang palaces, depleting state resources

title_zh: 罗马皇帝亚历山大·塞维鲁在美因茨被叛军杀害，塞维鲁王朝终结
title_en: Roman emperor Severus Alexander killed by mutinous soldiers at Mainz; Severan dynasty ends

title_zh: 戈迪安一世在非洲被元老院拥立为帝，后兵败自杀
title_en: Gordian I proclaimed emperor in Africa by the Senate, then commits suicide after defeat

title_zh: 罗马皇帝戈迪安三世被迫与萨珊波斯议和，专注对付国内叛乱
title_en: Roman emperor Gordian III forced to make peace with Sasanian Persia to focus on internal rebellions

title_zh: 罗马元老院与军队扶植的皇帝马克西米努斯矛盾激化
title_en: Conflict intensifies between the Roman Senate and the army‑proclaimed emperor Maximinus

title_zh: 公孙渊自立为燕王，公开反叛曹魏
title_en: Gongsun Yuan declares himself King of Yan, openly rebelling against Cao Wei

title_zh: 罗马帝国非洲行省爆发叛乱，元老院与军队冲突激化
title_en: Rebellion breaks out in the Roman province of Africa; conflict between Senate and army intensifies

title_zh: 魏明帝曹叡病逝，司马懿与曹爽受命辅政
title_en: Emperor Ming of Wei (Cao Rui) dies; Sima Yi and Cao Shuang appointed regents

title_zh: 司马懿率军平定辽东，斩杀公孙渊
title_en: Sima Yi leads army to pacify Liaodong, killing Gongsun Yuan

title_zh: 日本邪马台国女王卑弥呼遣使至曹魏，受封“亲魏倭王”
title_en: Queen Himiko of Yamatai in Japan sends envoys to Cao Wei, receives title 'Pro‑Wei King of Wa'

title_zh: 哥特人联合部落再次大举入侵罗马，劫掠巴尔干
title_en: Goths, allied with other tribes, again invade Roman territory on a large scale, plundering the Balkans

title_zh: 曹爽与司马懿共同辅政，但曹爽独揽大权，排斥司马懿
title_en: Cao Shuang and Sima Yi serve as co‑regents, but Cao Shuang monopolizes power and excludes Sima Yi

title_zh: 罗马帝国内乱，多位皇帝更迭，年号纪年混乱
title_en: Roman civil wars see multiple emperors; chronological chaos

title_zh: 曹爽率军伐蜀，被蜀汉大将费祎、王平击败
title_en: Cao Shuang leads an army to attack Shu, but is defeated by Shu generals Fei Yi and Wang Ping

title_zh: 阿拉伯人菲利普同情基督教，迫害仍未止息
title_en: Philip the Arab sympathizes with Christianity, yet persecution continues

title_zh: 斯里兰卡佛教大寺（Mahavihara）建立，成为上座部佛教中心
title_en: The Mahavihara monastery in Sri Lanka is established, becoming a center of Theravada Buddhism

title_zh: 阿拉伯人菲利普被军队拥立为罗马皇帝
title_en: Philip the Arab is proclaimed Roman emperor by the army

title_zh: 何晏、王弼开创玄学，清谈之风开始在士大夫中流行
title_en: He Yan and Wang Bi initiate Xuanxue (Neo‑Daoism); the fashion for 'pure conversation' begins among scholar‑officials

title_zh: 王弼以玄学注易经老子
title_en: Wang Bi and Xuanxue Neo-Daoism

title_zh: 东吴全琮率军攻魏，被魏军击败
title_en: Eastern Wu's Quan Cong attacks Wei, is defeated

title_zh: 萨珊波斯军队攻占亚美尼亚西部，迫使其成为藩属
title_en: Sasanian Persian army occupies western Armenia, making it a client state

title_zh: 萨珊帝国沙普尔一世即位，继承其父扩张政策
title_en: Shapur I of the Sasanian Empire succeeds his father and continues his expansionist policies

title_zh: 哥特人首次大规模入侵罗马帝国腹地，劫掠多瑙河沿岸
title_en: Goths invade the Roman heartland for the first time, plundering the Danube banks

title_zh: 魏国扬州都督王凌在淮南广开屯田，积蓄军粮
title_en: Wei's Yangzhou commander Wang Ling promotes military colonies in Huainan, storing grain

title_zh: 蜀汉大将军蒋琬规划从汉水、沔水水路伐魏，但未实施
title_en: Shu Han's Grand General Jiang Wan plans a river‑borne invasion of Wei from the Han and Mian rivers, but does not implement it

title_zh: 司马懿为迷惑曹爽，假装年老病重，暗中联络心腹
title_en: Sima Yi feigns old age and illness to deceive Cao Shuang, secretly contacting his confidants

title_zh: 费祎出任蜀汉大将军，继续蒋琬休养生息政策
title_en: Fei Yi becomes Grand General of Shu Han, continuing Jiang Wan's policy of rest and recuperation

title_zh: 曹爽专权骄奢，排斥异己，朝野离心
title_en: Cao Shuang, monopolizing power, lives extravagantly and alienates the court, causing popular discontent

title_zh: 罗马少年皇帝戈迪安三世在东征途中神秘去世
title_en: Teenage Roman emperor Gordian III mysteriously dies during an eastern campaign

title_zh: 普罗提诺创立新柏拉图主义
title_en: Plotinus founds Neoplatonism

title_zh: 罗马皇帝阿拉伯人菲利普被部下德基乌斯逼迫退位并杀害
title_en: Roman emperor Philip the Arab is forced to abdicate and killed by his subordinate Decius

title_zh: 东吴开凿破冈渎运河，连接秦淮河和太湖水系
title_en: Eastern Wu digs the Pogandu Canal, linking the Qinhuai River and the Lake Tai basin

title_zh: 罗马皇帝德基乌斯大规模迫害基督徒，要求全民献祭
title_en: Roman emperor Decius orders universal sacrifice, launching a large‑scale persecution of Christians

title_zh: 罗马皇帝阿拉伯人菲利普与萨珊波斯讲和，确认现有边界
title_en: Roman emperor Philip the Arab makes peace with Sasanian Persia, confirming existing borders

title_zh: 罗马皇帝德基乌斯战死在阿伯里图斯战役中
title_en: Roman emperor Decius is killed at the Battle of Abritus

title_zh: 罗马将领加卢斯继位，向哥特人求和
title_en: Roman general Gallus succeeds, making peace with the Goths

title_zh: 日本邪马台国女王壹与遣使入贡曹魏
title_en: Queen Yi‑yo of Yamatai sends envoys to Cao Wei

title_zh: 哥特人再次越过多瑙河，入侵罗马巴尔干行省
title_en: Goths again cross the Danube and invade the Roman Balkan provinces

title_zh: 蜀汉凉州边境发生少数民族叛乱，姜维率军平定
title_en: Rebellion of minority tribes breaks out on Shu Han's Liangzhou border; Jiang Wei leads army to pacify it

title_zh: 罗马帝国爆发严重瘟疫，人口大量死亡
title_en: A severe plague ravages the Roman Empire, causing massive loss of life

title_zh: 哥特人继续侵扰罗马边境，并劫掠爱琴海沿岸
title_en: Goths continue raiding Roman borders and plunder the Aegean coast

title_zh: 哥特人围攻巴尔干半岛的马尔西安堡，久攻不克
title_en: Goths besiege Marcianopolis in the Balkans but fail to take it

title_zh: 司马懿与曹爽矛盾激化，政变一触即发
title_en: Conflict between Sima Yi and Cao Shuang intensifies; a coup is imminent

title_zh: 罗马举行建城千年庆典
title_en: Rome celebrates its thousandth year

title_zh: 瓦莱里安被军队拥立为罗马皇帝，结束短期混乱
title_en: Valerian is proclaimed Roman emperor, ending the brief period of chaos

title_zh: 司马懿发动高平陵之变，铲除曹爽集团，独揽魏国大权
title_en: Sima Yi launches the Coup of the Gaoping Tombs, eliminates Cao Shuang's faction, and monopolizes Wei power

title_zh: 罗马帝国加卢斯被部下埃米利安努斯推翻，随即被杀
title_en: Roman emperor Gallus is overthrown by his subordinate Aemilianus and then killed

title_zh: 罗马皇帝德基乌斯在阿伯里图斯战死后，军队拥立德西乌斯为帝
title_en: After Emperor Decius dies at the Battle of Abrittus, the army proclaims Gallus as emperor

title_zh: 邪马台国
title_en: Yamatai state

title_zh: 司马懿镇压淮南王凌叛乱，清除王凌势力
title_en: Sima Yi suppresses the rebellion of Wang Ling, eliminating his power base

title_zh: 罗马皇帝德西乌斯（德基乌斯）发动基督教大规模迫害
title_en: Roman emperor Decius launches a large‑scale persecution of Christians

title_zh: 孙权因后宫之争废太子孙和，引发东吴内部动荡
title_en: Sun Quan, due to a succession dispute, dethrones his eldest son Sun He, causing internal turmoil in Eastern Wu

title_zh: 玛雅文明古典时期开始
title_en: Maya Classic period begins

title_zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎文明进入鼎盛时期，建成太阳金字塔
title_en: Teotihuacan civilization reaches its zenith; the Sun Pyramid is completed

title_zh: 罗马皇帝瓦莱里安与萨珊波斯开战，收复部分失地
title_en: Roman emperor Valerian goes to war with Sasanian Persia, recovering some lost territory

title_zh: 魏国权臣司马懿病逝，追谥宣文侯
title_en: Wei regent Sima Yi dies; posthumous title Xuanwen Hou

title_zh: 罗马皇帝瓦莱里安在东方战场溃败，被萨珊波斯俘虏
title_en: Roman emperor Valerian is routed in the east and captured by the Sasanian Persians

title_zh: 司马师接替司马懿掌权，整顿朝纲
title_en: Sima Shi succeeds Sima Yi in power and reorganizes the government

title_zh: 罗马皇帝德西乌斯（德基乌斯）在与哥特人的阿伯里图斯战役中战死
title_en: Roman emperor Decius is killed at the Battle of Abritus against the Goths

title_zh: 东吴大帝孙权病逝，享年71岁
title_en: Sun Quan, Emperor Da of Wu, dies at the age of 71

title_zh: 诸葛恪以太傅总揽东吴朝政，成为权臣
title_en: Zhuge Ke, as Grand Tutor, takes charge of Eastern Wu's government, becoming a powerful regent

title_zh: 郭象注《庄子》
title_en: Guo Xiang comments on the Zhuangzi

title_zh: 哥特人组建舰队，从黑海南下袭击罗马小亚细亚沿海
title_en: Goths build a fleet and attack Roman coastal cities in Asia Minor from the Black Sea

title_zh: 蜀汉大将军费祎被魏国降将刺杀身亡
title_en: Shu Han Grand General Fei Yi is assassinated by a surrendered Wei general

title_zh: 罗马帝国边境全线告急，高卢、潘诺尼亚、叙利亚等地同时爆发叛乱和入侵
title_en: All Roman frontiers are in crisis; rebellions and invasions break out simultaneously in Gaul, Pannonia, and Syria

title_zh: 罗马皇帝加里恩努斯在父亲瓦莱里安被俘后，独自统治帝国西部
title_en: Roman emperor Gallienus, after his father Valerian's capture, rules the western empire alone

title_zh: 东吴权臣诸葛恪率二十万大军北伐，新城惨败
title_en: Eastern Wu regent Zhuge Ke leads 200,000 troops north and suffers a disastrous defeat at Xincheng

title_zh: 罗马皇帝瓦莱里安被萨珊波斯俘虏，成为波斯国王脚凳
title_en: Roman emperor Valerian is captured by Sasanian Persia and made a footstool for the Persian king

title_zh: 法兰克人入侵高卢，摧毁罗马边境防线
title_en: Franks invade Gaul, destroying Roman border defenses

title_zh: 罗马皇帝加里恩努斯推行军事改革，建立以骑兵为主的机动野战军
title_en: Roman emperor Gallienus institutes military reforms, creating a mobile field army based on cavalry

title_zh: 司马师废黜皇帝曹芳，改立曹髦为帝
title_en: Sima Shi deposes Emperor Cao Fang and installs Cao Mao as emperor

title_zh: 东吴权臣孙峻诛杀诸葛恪，掌握朝政
title_en: Eastern Wu regent Sun Jun kills Zhuge Ke and takes control

title_zh: 萨珊波斯沙普尔一世攻占罗马重镇安条克，掳走大量人口
title_en: Sasanian Shapur I captures the Roman city of Antioch, deporting its population

title_zh: 蜀汉姜维北伐，在狄道大破魏将王经
title_en: Shu Han's Jiang Wei conducts a northern expedition, defeating Wei general Wang Jing at Didao

title_zh: 罗马皇帝加里恩努斯在意大利北部击退阿勒曼尼人入侵
title_en: Roman emperor Gallienus repulses Alamanni invasion of northern Italy

title_zh: 司马师平定毌丘俭、文钦淮南之乱后病逝，司马昭接掌大权
title_en: Sima Shi suppresses the rebellion of Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin, then dies; Sima Zhao takes power

title_zh: 东吴权臣孙峻病逝，其堂弟孙綝专权
title_en: Eastern Wu regent Sun Jun dies; his cousin Sun Chen seizes power

title_zh: 罗马西部行省高卢帝国正式脱离罗马独立
title_en: The Gallic Empire formally secedes from Rome, controlling Gaul, Britain, and Spain

title_zh: 姜维在洮西之战后乘胜围攻狄道，被魏军击退
title_en: After his victory at Taoxi, Jiang Wei besieges Didao but is repelled

title_zh: 罗马皇帝瓦莱里安颁布诏书，再次迫害基督教，处死主教和神职人员
title_en: Roman emperor Valerian issues an edict again ordering persecution of Christians, executing bishops and clergy

title_zh: 高卢帝国在波斯图穆斯统治下巩固疆域，发行独立钱币
title_en: The Gallic Empire, under Postumus, consolidates its territory and issues its own coinage

title_zh: 魏国征东大将军诸葛诞在寿春举兵反司马昭
title_en: Wei's General Who Conquers the East, Zhuge Dan, raises troops at Shouchun against Sima Zhao

title_zh: 东吴孙綝废黜孙亮，改立孙休为帝，随后孙休诛杀孙綝
title_en: Eastern Wu's Sun Chen deposes Sun Liang and installs Sun Xiu; Sun Xiu then kills Sun Chen

title_zh: 司马昭长期围困寿春，最终攻克，诸葛诞被杀
title_en: Sima Zhao, after a long siege, captures Shouchun and kills Zhuge Dan

title_zh: 萨珊波斯沙普尔一世在埃德萨之战中俘虏罗马皇帝瓦莱里安
title_en: Sasanian Persian Shapur I captures Roman emperor Valerian at the Battle of Edessa

title_zh: 罗马皇帝加里恩努斯在东方成功抵御波斯，收复部分失地
title_en: Roman emperor Gallienus successfully resists the Persians in the east, recovering some lost territory

title_zh: 皇甫谧撰《针灸甲乙经》
title_en: Huangfu Mi's acupuncture classic

title_zh: 帕尔米拉王国在奥登纳图斯领导下崛起，成为东方强权
title_en: The Palmyrene kingdom rises under Odaenathus, becoming a power in the east

title_zh: 魏帝曹髦密谋诛杀司马昭，召集侍中王沈、尚书王经等谋划
title_en: Wei emperor Cao Mao secretly plots with his attendants to kill Sima Zhao

title_zh: 罗马皇帝加里恩努斯忙于应对各地危机，无暇东顾，哥特人肆虐巴尔干
title_en: Roman emperor Gallienus, busy with crises everywhere, neglects the east; Goths ravage the Balkans

title_zh: 嵇康作《琴赋》
title_en: Ji Kang writes Qin Fu

title_zh: 司马昭在曹髦被杀后立曹奂为帝
title_en: After Cao Mao is killed, Sima Zhao installs Cao Huan as emperor

title_zh: 罗马皇帝加里恩努斯在米兰被部下刺杀，克劳狄二世继位
title_en: Roman emperor Gallienus is assassinated by his officers at Milan; Claudius II succeeds

title_zh: 魏帝曹髦率军讨伐司马昭，被成济刺杀于南阙
title_en: Wei emperor Cao Mao leads troops against Sima Zhao and is killed at the Southern Gate

title_zh: 司马昭筹划伐蜀，派遣钟会、邓艾等观察蜀汉虚实
title_en: Sima Zhao plans to conquer Shu, sending Zhong Hui and Deng Ai to reconnoiter

title_zh: 蜀汉姜维因避黄皓陷害，率军屯田沓中，自保避祸
title_en: Shu Han's Jiang Wei, to avoid the eunuch Huang Hao, goes to Tazhong to farm and avoid trouble

title_zh: 帕尔米拉王国奥登纳图斯统一叙利亚，自立为王
title_en: Odaenathus of Palmyra unites Syria and proclaims himself king

title_zh: 嵇康越名教任自然
title_en: Ji Kang and liberated naturalness

title_zh: 罗马皇帝克劳狄二世病逝，奥勒良继位，开始统一帝国
title_en: Roman emperor Claudius II dies of illness; Aurelian succeeds, beginning the reunification of the empire

title_zh: 高卢帝国末代皇帝泰特里库斯巩固统治，但内部矛盾加剧
title_en: The last emperor of the Gallic Empire, Tetricus, consolidates his rule, but internal contradictions intensify

title_zh: 姜维最后一次北伐，兵败邓艾，从此不再北伐
title_en: Jiang Wei's last northern expedition is defeated by Deng Ai; he never again undertakes a campaign

title_zh: 邓艾偷渡阴平，灭亡蜀汉
title_en: Deng Ai takes the Yinping shortcut and destroys Shu Han

title_zh: 魏国伐蜀，邓艾出阴平小道，钟会出斜谷，三路攻蜀
title_en: Wei attacks Shu; Deng Ai takes the Yinping shortcut, Zhong Hui attacks via the Xie Valley

title_zh: 钟会与邓艾内讧，邓艾被捕，钟会反叛被杀
title_en: Zhong Hui and Deng Ai fall out; Deng Ai is arrested, Zhong Hui rebels and is killed

title_zh: 姜维假意投降钟会，密谋复国，事败被杀
title_en: Jiang Wei pretends to surrender to Zhong Hui, plots to restore Shu, but the plot fails and he is killed

title_zh: 司马昭因灭蜀之功进爵晋王，加九锡
title_en: For his achievement in conquering Shu, Sima Zhao is made King of Jin, granted the Nine Bestowals

title_zh: 帕尔米拉统治者奥登纳图斯被表弟刺杀，其妻芝诺比阿摄政
title_en: Palmyra's ruler Odaenathus is assassinated by his cousin; his wife Zenobia becomes regent

title_zh: 罗马皇帝奥勒良率军东征，准备统一帝国，击败帕尔米拉
title_en: Roman emperor Aurelian leads his army east to reunify the empire, defeating Palmyra

title_zh: 东吴孙皓即位，是为吴末帝
title_en: Sun Hao of Eastern Wu ascends the throne, known as the Last Emperor of Wu

title_zh: 罗马皇帝奥勒良攻陷帕尔米拉，俘虏芝诺比阿，统一东部
title_en: Roman emperor Aurelian captures Palmyra, takes Zenobia prisoner, reunifying the east

title_zh: 司马炎大封宗室二十七王，允许诸王拥有军队，埋下八王之乱隐患
title_en: Sima Yan enfeoffs twenty‑seven imperial clan members as kings, allowing them to maintain armies, planting the seeds of the War of the Eight Princes

title_zh: 司马昭病逝，其子司马炎继位晋王，随即迫魏帝禅让，建立西晋
title_en: Sima Zhao dies; his son Sima Yan succeeds as King of Jin, then forces the Wei emperor to abdicate, establishing the Western Jin

title_zh: 罗马元老院推举塔西佗继位皇帝，但不久去世
title_en: The Roman Senate elects Tacitus as emperor, but he soon dies

title_zh: 罗马皇帝普罗布斯被军队拥立为帝，继续奥勒良政策
title_en: Roman emperor Probus is proclaimed emperor by the army and continues Aurelian's policies

title_zh: 罗马皇帝奥勒良在出征萨珊途中被近臣刺杀
title_en: Roman emperor Aurelian is assassinated by his staff while on campaign against the Sasanians

title_zh: 晋武帝司马炎整顿内政，推行户调式，削减奢侈开支
title_en: Emperor Wu of Jin reorganizes internal administration, implements the household tax system, and cuts luxury expenses

title_zh: 芝诺比阿统治帕尔米拉
title_en: Zenobia rules Palmyra

title_zh: 西晋地图学家裴秀绘制《禹贡地域图》，提出制图六体
title_en: Western Jin cartographer Pei Xiu draws the 'Yu Gong Regional Map' and proposes the six principles of cartography

title_zh: 罗马皇帝普罗布斯击败入侵高卢的日耳曼部落，恢复莱茵河防线
title_en: Roman emperor Probus defeats the Germanic tribes invading Gaul, restoring the Rhine frontier

title_zh: 西晋与东吴在荆州边境发生小规模冲突
title_en: Small‑scale skirmishes break out between Western Jin and Eastern Wu on the Jingzhou border

title_zh: 帕尔米拉国王奥登纳图斯被刺杀，芝诺比阿掌权
title_en: Palmyra's king Odaenathus is assassinated; Zenobia takes power

title_zh: 裴秀制图六体
title_en: Pei Xiu's cartography

title_zh: 罗马皇帝普罗布斯在高卢地区清剿残余蛮族，恢复秩序
title_en: Roman emperor Probus clears remaining barbarians from Gaul and restores order

title_zh: 东吴末帝孙皓暴政加剧，诛杀忠臣，导致东吴政治更加黑暗
title_en: Sun Hao, Last Emperor of Wu, becomes more tyrannical, killing loyal ministers, making Eastern Wu politics even darker

title_zh: 罗马皇帝克劳狄二世（哥特征服者）率军大败哥特人于纳伊苏斯
title_en: Roman emperor Claudius II (Gothicus) decisively defeats the Goths at Naissus

title_zh: 鲜卑秃发部在凉州起兵反晋，晋军讨伐不利
title_en: The Xianbei Tufa tribe rebels in Liangzhou; Jin forces are sent but suffer defeat

title_zh: 萨珊波斯沙普尔一世去世，其子霍尔米兹德一世继位
title_en: Shapur I of Sasanian Persia dies; his son Hormizd I succeeds

title_zh: 罗马皇帝普罗布斯在锡尔米乌姆被士兵杀害
title_en: Roman emperor Probus is killed by his soldiers at Sirmium

title_zh: 罗马皇帝卡鲁斯继位，对萨珊波斯宣战，恢复东方霸权
title_en: Roman emperor Carus succeeds, declares war on Sasanian Persia, and restores Roman dominance in the east

title_zh: 西晋与鲜卑秃发树机能战争持续，晋军损失惨重
title_en: The war between Western Jin and the Xianbei Tufa Shujineng continues, with heavy Jin losses

title_zh: 罗马皇帝奥勒良（Aurelian）开始修建奥勒良城墙，保卫罗马城
title_en: Roman emperor Aurelian begins construction of the Aurelian Walls to protect the city of Rome

title_zh: 埃及基督教圣女圣凯瑟琳因拒绝向罗马诸神献祭被处死
title_en: Egyptian Christian saint Catherine of Alexandria is executed for refusing to sacrifice to the Roman gods

title_zh: 蜀汉后主刘禅在洛阳去世，谥号思公
title_en: Liu Shan, Later Lord of Shu Han, dies in Luoyang; posthumous title Duke Si

title_zh: 帕尔米拉女王芝诺比阿率军占领埃及，切断罗马粮食供应
title_en: Queen Zenobia of Palmyra leads her army to occupy Egypt, cutting off Rome's grain supply

title_zh: 晋朝大将羊祜在荆州推行怀柔政策，与东吴陆抗保持边界和平
title_en: Jin general Yang Hu pursues a policy of conciliation in Jingzhou, maintaining peace on the border with Wu's Lu Kang

title_zh: 西晋益州刺史王濬开始在蜀地制造大型战船，准备伐吴
title_en: Wang Jun, governor of Yizhou under Western Jin, begins building large warships in Shu, preparing to attack Wu

title_zh: 东吴暴君孙皓杀害名将陆抗的家族成员，陆抗敢怒不敢言
title_en: Sun Hao, the tyrant of Eastern Wu, kills members of Lu Kang's family; Lu Kang, though angry, dares not speak out

title_zh: 罗马皇帝卡鲁斯东征时神秘死亡，其子努梅里安继位
title_en: Roman emperor Carus dies mysteriously during his eastern campaign; his son Numerian succeeds

title_zh: 罗马皇帝奥勒良（Aurelian）攻陷帕尔米拉，彻底征服东方
title_en: Roman emperor Aurelian captures Palmyra, completely conquering the east

title_zh: 君士坦丁大帝出生
title_en: Constantine born

title_zh: 罗马军队攻陷帕尔米拉后，彻底摧毁该城
title_en: After Palmyra surrenders, the Roman army completely destroys the city

title_zh: 罗马皇帝努梅里安病逝，戴克里先被军队拥立为帝，开启罗马复兴
title_en: Roman emperor Numerian dies; Diocletian is proclaimed emperor by the army, initiating Rome's revival

title_zh: 晋武帝为充实后宫，下令选美，禁止天下婚嫁
title_en: Emperor Wu of Jin, seeking to fill his harem, orders a selection of beauties and forbids marriage throughout the realm

title_zh: 罗马帝国重新统一，奥勒良收复高卢帝国后，帝国领土再次统一
title_en: The Roman Empire is reunified; after Aurelian recovers the Gallic Empire, the empire is again united under one ruler

title_zh: 羊祜上《请伐吴疏》，请求晋武帝立即伐吴
title_en: Yang Hu presents his memorial 'On the Necessity of Attacking Wu', urging Emperor Wu of Jin to attack immediately

title_zh: 戴克里先任命马克西米安为凯撒，负责帝国西部防务
title_en: Diocletian appoints Maximian as Caesar to take charge of the western defense

title_zh: 罗马皇帝奥勒良在小亚细亚被部下刺杀
title_en: Roman emperor Aurelian is assassinated by his officers in Asia Minor

title_zh: 鲜卑秃发树机能继续反晋，攻陷凉州重镇
title_en: The Xianbei Tufa Shujineng continues his rebellion, capturing the major city of Liangzhou

title_zh: 晋武帝改元咸宁，象征太平时日到来
title_en: Emperor Wu of Jin changes the era name to Xianning, symbolizing an era of peace

title_zh: 羊祜病重，临终前举荐杜预接替其职务，继续筹划灭吴
title_en: Yang Hu, gravely ill, on his deathbed recommends Du Yu to succeed him and continue planning the conquest of Wu

title_zh: 罗马皇帝戴克里先改革币制，发行金、银、铜新币，稳定经济
title_en: Roman emperor Diocletian reforms the coinage, issuing new gold, silver, and bronze coins to stabilize the economy

title_zh: 罗马皇帝普罗布斯恢复莱茵河和多瑙河边境，重建边防
title_en: Roman emperor Probus restores the Rhine and Danube frontiers, rebuilding border defenses

title_zh: 西晋在益州、荆州大造战船，训练水军，准备灭吴
title_en: Western Jin builds large numbers of warships in Yizhou and Jingzhou, training its navy to destroy Wu

title_zh: 戴克里先率军镇压埃及叛乱，加强东方行省控制
title_en: Diocletian leads an army to suppress a rebellion in Egypt, strengthening control over the eastern provinces

title_zh: 罗马军队在皇帝普罗布斯率领下彻底恢复莱茵河防线
title_en: The Roman army, under Emperor Probus, fully restores the Rhine frontier

title_zh: 罗马皇帝普罗布斯肃清多瑙河下游蛮族
title_en: Emperor Probus clears the barbarians from the lower Danube

title_zh: 萨珊波斯与罗马在美索不达米亚再度爆发冲突，双方互有胜负
title_en: Sasanian Persia and Rome clash again in Mesopotamia; neither side gains a decisive advantage

title_zh: 杜预在荆州实施突袭，夺取东吴江陵外围据点
title_en: Du Yu carries out night raids in Jingzhou, capturing outposts on the Wu side of Jiangling

title_zh: 罗马皇帝普罗布斯鼓励在边境地区种植葡萄，发展经济
title_en: Roman emperor Probus encourages vine‑growing on the frontiers to develop the economy

title_zh: 马隆率三千五百人西征，一举平定凉州鲜卑叛乱
title_en: Ma Long leads 3,500 men west, puts down the Xianbei rebellion in Liangzhou

title_zh: 西晋益州刺史王濬在蜀地建成大规模舰队，准备东下灭吴
title_en: Wang Jun, governor of Yizhou of Western Jin, completes construction of a huge fleet in Shu, ready to sail east to conquer Wu

title_zh: 西晋发六路大军二十余万，水陆并进，发动灭吴之战
title_en: Western Jin launches a six‑pronged invasion of Wu, with over 200,000 men, by land and water, beginning the campaign to destroy Wu

title_zh: 戴克里先正式建立四帝共治制，任命马克西米安为西部奥古斯都
title_en: Diocletian formally establishes the Tetrarchy, appointing Maximian as Augustus of the west

title_zh: 西晋水陆并进，攻陷建业，东吴灭亡，三国终归一统
title_en: Western Jin advances by land and water, captures Jianye, and ends Eastern Wu; the Three Kingdoms are finally unified

title_zh: 西晋灭吴后，下令裁减州郡兵，简化军事编制
title_en: After the conquest of Wu, Western Jin orders the reduction of provincial armies, simplifying the military establishment

title_zh: 西晋统一全国后，实行太康盛世，社会经济得到恢复
title_en: After the unification of China, Western Jin enjoys the Taikang era of peace, with social and economic recovery

title_zh: 王叔和编《脉经》
title_en: Wang Shuhe compiles the Pulse Classic

title_zh: 西晋汲郡古墓出土《竹书纪年》等大批战国竹简
title_en: The Jijun tomb in Western Jin yields a large cache of Warring States bamboo slips, including the 'Bamboo Annals'

title_zh: 罗马皇帝普罗布斯镇压高卢巴高达运动（农民起义），恢复秩序
title_en: Roman emperor Probus suppresses the Bagaudae uprising in Gaul, restoring order

title_zh: 东吴末帝孙皓在洛阳去世，封归命侯
title_en: Sun Hao, the Last Emperor of Wu, dies in Luoyang; his title is Marquis of Guiming

title_zh: 戴克里先巩固统治，与萨珊波斯保持和平
title_en: Diocletian consolidates his rule, maintaining peace with Sasanian Persia

title_zh: 卡鲁斯之子卡里努斯与努梅里安争夺帝位，罗马内乱
title_en: Carus's sons Carinus and Numerian fight for the throne; Roman civil war

title_zh: 西晋太康盛世持续发展，经济繁荣，人口增长
title_en: The Taikang prosperity continues to develop under Western Jin, with a growing economy and population

title_zh: 戴克里先任命马克西米安为奥古斯都，正式确立四帝共治
title_en: Diocletian appoints Maximian as Augustus, formally establishing the Tetrarchy

title_zh: 罗马皇帝卡鲁斯率军东征萨珊波斯，攻陷泰西封
title_en: Roman emperor Carus leads an army east against the Sasanian Persians, capturing Ctesiphon

title_zh: 晋武帝下诏诸王公就国，实际上仍有部分留在京城
title_en: Emperor Wu of Jin orders the princes to go to their fiefs, but many remain in the capital

title_zh: 罗马军官戴克里先被军队拥立为皇帝，开启帝国复兴时期
title_en: The Roman officer Diocletian is proclaimed emperor by his troops, ushering in a period of imperial revival

title_zh: 鲜卑慕容廆遣使至西晋进贡，受封鲜卑都督
title_en: The Xianbei Murong Gui sends envoys to pay tribute to Western Jin and is appointed Xianbei governor

title_zh: 戴克里先对罗马帝国进行全面改革，包括行政、军事、财政
title_en: Diocletian launches a comprehensive reform of the Roman Empire, including administration, military, and finances

title_zh: 西晋继续推行休养生息政策，全国户口大幅增加
title_en: Western Jin continues its policy of rest and development, with a marked increase in the number of households

title_zh: 鲜卑慕容部在首领慕容廆领导下逐步强盛，控制辽西
title_en: Under Murong Gui, the Murong Xianbei gradually grow strong and control western Liaoning

title_zh: 罗马皇帝卡鲁斯东征波斯，取得重大胜利
title_en: Roman emperor Carus campaigns against the Sasanian Persians, winning a major victory

title_zh: 戴克里先开始全面改革罗马帝国，包括行政、军事和经济
title_en: Diocletian begins comprehensive reforms of the Roman Empire, including administration, military, and economy

title_zh: 戴克里先改革军制，将野战军与边防军分离
title_en: Diocletian reforms the military, separating field armies from frontier forces

title_zh: 西晋贵族石崇与王恺斗富，竞相展示奢侈
title_en: Western Jin aristocrats Shi Chong and Wang Kai compete in ostentatious luxury

title_zh: 马克西米安被戴克里先任命为西部奥古斯都
title_en: Maximian is appointed Augustus of the West by Diocletian

title_zh: 西晋朝臣奢侈成风，贿赂公行，吏治败坏
title_en: Under Western Jin, official extravagance and bribery become rampant; government becomes corrupt

title_zh: 罗马将军君士坦提乌斯率军收复不列颠，击败卡劳西乌斯
title_en: Roman general Constantius Chlorus leads a campaign to reconquer Britain, defeating Carausius

title_zh: 罗马将领卡劳西乌斯在不列颠自立为帝，建立不列颠帝国
title_en: Roman commander Carausius proclaims himself emperor in Britain, establishing the Britannic Empire

title_zh: 罗马帝国与萨珊波斯在东部边境维持小规模冲突，未有大战
title_en: Small‑scale clashes continue between the Roman Empire and Sasanian Persia on the eastern frontier, no major war

title_zh: 戴克里先改革税制，实行土地和人头税结合的制度
title_en: Diocletian reforms the tax system, combining land and poll taxes

title_zh: 晋武帝司马炎沉溺享乐，朝政日非
title_en: Emperor Wu of Jin indulges in pleasure, and government affairs decline

title_zh: 西晋统一后，全国经济文化繁荣，太康文学兴起
title_en: After the unification, Western Jin enjoys economic and cultural prosperity; Taikang literature flourishes

title_zh: 鲜卑慕容廆迁居徒河（今辽宁锦州），发展势力
title_en: The Xianbei Murong Gui moves his people to Tuhe (modern Jinzhou, Liaoning) to develop his power

title_zh: 戴克里先与马克西米安在米兰举行会谈，协调四帝共治
title_en: Diocletian and Maximian meet in Milan to coordinate the Tetrarchy

title_zh: 晋武帝分封诸王都督军事，赋予实权，埋下内乱祸根
title_en: Emperor Wu of Jin enfeoffs the imperial princes as regional commanders with real military power, planting the seeds of civil war

title_zh: 贾南风被立为皇后，日后干政专权
title_en: Jia Nanfeng is installed as empress; later she will meddle in politics

title_zh: 外戚杨骏独揽朝政，排挤宗室大臣
title_en: The consort clan member Yang Jun monopolizes the government, excluding the imperial princes

title_zh: 晋武帝司马炎病逝，结束太康盛世
title_en: Emperor Wu of Jin (Sima Yan) dies of illness, ending the Taikang prosperity

title_zh: 张华出任司空，在贾后手下维持政局相对稳定
title_en: Zhang Hua becomes Minister of Works, maintaining relative stability under Empress Jia

title_zh: 八王之乱第一阶段：贾后联合司马亮、司马玮铲除杨骏
title_en: First phase of the War of the Eight Princes: Empress Jia unites with Sima Liang and Sima Wei to eliminate Yang Jun, then turns on them

title_zh: 贾后杀司马亮和卫瓘，专擅朝政
title_en: Empress Jia kills Sima Liang and Wei Guan, seizing full control of the government

title_zh: 戴克里先加强东方边境防御，修建一系列要塞
title_en: Diocletian strengthens the eastern frontier, building a series of forts

title_zh: 贾后在朝中安插亲信，巩固权力，但政事仍由张华主持
title_en: Empress Jia places her own people in key positions to consolidate power, but state affairs remain under Zhang Hua

title_zh: 戴克里先推行行政改革，将行省划小，增加行省数量至近100个
title_en: Diocletian carries out administrative reforms, dividing provinces into smaller units, increasing the number to nearly 100

title_zh: 戴克里先正式确立四帝共治制
title_en: Diocletian formally establishes the Tetrarchy

title_zh: 戴克里先推行币制改革，发行金币、银币和铜币
title_en: Diocletian reforms the coinage, issuing gold, silver, and bronze coins

title_zh: 戴克里先镇压埃及南部叛乱，加强控制
title_en: Diocletian suppresses a rebellion in southern Egypt, tightening control

title_zh: 匈奴郝散在上党起兵反晋，不久失败
title_en: The Xiongnu rebel Hao San rises in Shangdang, but is soon defeated

title_zh: 洛阳武库发生大火，烧毁大量兵器铠甲
title_en: A great fire breaks out in the Luoyang arsenal, burning a huge quantity of weapons and armor

title_zh: 鲜卑宇文部击败慕容部，慕容廆逃往辽东
title_en: The Xianbei Yuwen tribe defeats the Murong tribe; Murong Gui flees to Liaodong

title_zh: 罗马帝国对萨珊波斯发动战争，加勒里乌斯初战失利
title_en: Roman Empire goes to war with Sasanian Persia; Galerius is initially defeated

title_zh: 关中荒旱，大量流民涌入蜀地，引发社会动荡
title_en: Drought in Guanzhong leads to a large influx of refugees into Shu, causing social unrest

title_zh: 罗马凯撒加勒里乌斯在波斯边境重整军队，准备反击
title_en: Roman Caesar Galerius regroups his forces on the Persian frontier, preparing a counterattack

title_zh: 氐人齐万年在关中起兵称帝，掀起反晋浪潮
title_en: The Di tribal leader Qi Wannian rises in Guanzhong and proclaims himself emperor

title_zh: 罗马凯撒加勒里乌斯率军再次进攻波斯，初战失利，但随后大胜
title_en: Roman Caesar Galerius attacks Persia again, initially defeated but then wins a great victory

title_zh: 戴克里先发布《物价敕令》，规定商品和服务最高价格
title_en: Diocletian issues the Edict on Maximum Prices, fixing maximum prices for goods and services

title_zh: 晋将周处在六陌之战中孤立无援，力战而死
title_en: The Jin general Zhou Chu fights at the Battle of Liuwu without support and dies in combat

title_zh: 西晋为镇压齐万年起义，军费剧增，国力严重损耗
title_en: Suppressing Qi Wannian's rebellion greatly increases Western Jin's military expenditure, depleting national strength

title_zh: 晋将孟观率精锐平定齐万年叛乱，斩杀齐万年
title_en: Jin general Meng Guan leads elite troops to suppress Qi Wannian's rebellion, killing Qi Wannian

title_zh: 罗马凯撒加勒里乌斯在亚美尼亚大败萨珊波斯国王纳尔塞斯
title_en: Roman Caesar Galerius defeats the Sasanian Persian king Narseh in Armenia

title_zh: 关中饥荒持续，李特率流民进入蜀地求生
title_en: Famine continues in Guanzhong; Li Te leads refugees into Shu to seek food

title_zh: 贾后废太子司马遹，引发众怒
title_en: Empress Jia deposes the crown prince Sima Yu, provoking widespread anger

title_zh: 戴克里先推行物价敕令，但收效甚微
title_en: Diocletian's Edict on Maximum Prices has little effect

title_zh: 罗马与萨珊波斯签订和约，维持和平近四十年
title_en: Rome and Sasanian Persia sign a peace treaty, maintaining peace for nearly forty years

title_zh: 西晋社会矛盾激化，流民起义此起彼伏
title_en: Social contradictions intensify in Western Jin; refugee uprisings erupt one after another

title_zh: 潘地亚王国鼎盛
title_en: The Pandya kingdom peaks

title_zh: 玛雅文明进入古典时期
title_en: Maya civilization enters the Classic period

title_zh: 加纳帝国兴起
title_en: Ghana Empire rises

title_zh: 亚美尼亚基督教化
title_en: Christianization of Armenia

title_zh: 赵王司马伦篡位称帝
title_en: Prince of Zhao Sima Lun usurps the throne and proclaims himself emperor

title_zh: 萨珊帝国与贵霜帝国边境冲突
title_en: Sasanian Empire clashes with the Kushan Empire on the border

title_zh: 罗马四帝共治体系内部矛盾激化
title_en: Internal conflicts intensify within the Roman Tetrarchy

title_zh: 长沙王司马乂杀齐王司马冏
title_en: Prince of Changsha Sima Yi kills Prince of Qi Sima Jiong

title_zh: 埃及沙漠隐修主义兴起：圣安东尼的传统形成
title_en: Rise of Egyptian desert monasticism: formation of the tradition of Saint Anthony

title_zh: 张昌在江夏起义
title_en: Zhang Chang rebels in Jiangxia

title_zh: 戴克里先颁布最大规模基督教迫害敕令
title_en: Diocletian issues the harshest edict against Christianity

title_zh: 李特在蜀地战败被杀，李雄继起领导流民
title_en: Li Te defeated and killed in Shu, Li Xiong leads the refugees

title_zh: 东海王司马越囚禁长沙王司马乂
title_en: Prince of Donghai Sima Yue imprisons Prince of Changsha Sima Yi

title_zh: 佛教在中国社会各阶层中广泛流行
title_en: Buddhism becomes widespread among all social strata in China

title_zh: 李雄在成都称王，建立成汉政权
title_en: Li Xiong proclaims himself king at Chengdu, establishing the Cheng-Han regime

title_zh: 刘渊在左国城称王，建立汉赵
title_en: Liu Yuan proclaims himself king at Zuoguo City, establishing Han-Zhao

title_zh: 东海王司马越起兵讨伐河间王司马颙与成都王司马颖
title_en: Prince of Donghai Sima Yue rises against Prince of Hejian Sima Yong and Prince of Chengdu Sima Ying

title_zh: 罗马皇帝戴克里先正式退位，四帝共治体系终结开端
title_en: Roman Emperor Diocletian formally abdicates, beginning the end of the Tetrarchy

title_zh: 基督教在阿克苏姆王国迅速发展，亚历山大教区影响力扩大
title_en: Christianity expands rapidly in the Kingdom of Aksum, growing influence of the Alexandrian diocese

title_zh: 西部奥古斯都君士坦提乌斯一世在不列颠去世
title_en: Western Augustus Constantius I dies in Britain

title_zh: 君士坦丁被不列颠军队拥立为罗马西部皇帝
title_en: Constantine is proclaimed Western Roman Emperor by the army in Britain

title_zh: 马克森提乌斯在罗马城自立为帝
title_en: Maxentius proclaims himself emperor in Rome

title_zh: 中国北方开始大规模开凿佛教石窟
title_en: Large-scale excavation of Buddhist grottoes begins in northern China

title_zh: 晋惠帝司马衷被毒死，晋怀帝司马炽即位
title_en: Emperor Hui of Jin is poisoned to death; Emperor Huai of Jin ascends the throne

title_zh: 王导为司马睿设计“镇之以静，群才毕至”策略
title_en: Wang Dao devises the strategy of 'govern with tranquility and attract all talents' for Sima Rui

title_zh: 东部皇帝伽列里乌斯正式承认君士坦丁为西部奥古斯都
title_en: Eastern Emperor Galerius formally recognizes Constantine as Western Augustus

title_zh: 司马睿出镇建邺，开始经营江东
title_en: Sima Rui is stationed at Jianye, beginning to manage Jiangdong

title_zh: 吐蕃早期部落联盟开始形成
title_en: Early tribal confederation of Tubo (Tibet) begins to form

title_zh: 刘渊正式称帝，建立汉赵帝国
title_en: Liu Yuan formally proclaims himself emperor, establishing the Han-Zhao Empire

title_zh: 李锡尼被东部皇帝伽列里乌斯任命为西部奥古斯都
title_en: Licinius is appointed Western Augustus by Eastern Emperor Galerius

title_zh: 石勒投奔刘渊，成为汉赵重要将领
title_en: Shi Le joins Liu Yuan, becoming an important general of Han-Zhao

title_zh: 石勒在河北山东地区大规模攻掠，建立根据地
title_en: Shi Le launches large-scale raids in Hebei and Shandong, establishing a base

title_zh: 汉赵皇帝刘渊两次进攻洛阳失败
title_en: Han-Zhao Emperor Liu Yuan's two attacks on Luoyang fail

title_zh: 李雄在成都正式称帝，建立成汉帝国
title_en: Li Xiong formally proclaims himself emperor at Chengdu, establishing the Cheng-Han Empire

title_zh: 大量北方游牧民族内迁中原，民族融合加速
title_en: Large-scale migration of northern nomadic peoples into the Central Plains accelerates ethnic integration

title_zh: 汉赵开国皇帝刘渊病逝，刘聪弑兄夺位
title_en: Han-Zhao founding emperor Liu Yuan dies; Liu Cong kills his brother and seizes the throne

title_zh: 石勒率军攻掠江淮地区，威胁江南
title_en: Shi Le leads raids on the Jianghuai region, threatening Jiangnan

title_zh: 罗马东部皇帝伽列里乌斯病逝，帝国权力重组
title_en: Roman Eastern Emperor Galerius dies, power restructured

title_zh: 永嘉之乱：汉赵刘聪攻陷洛阳，俘获晋怀帝
title_en: Disaster of Yongjia: Han-Zhao's Liu Cong captures Luoyang and takes Emperor Huai of Jin prisoner

title_zh: 司马睿在江南积聚实力，形成偏安政权雏形
title_en: Sima Rui builds power in Jiangnan, forming the nucleus of a refuge regime

title_zh: 罗马皇帝伽列里乌斯临终颁布宽容敕令，停止基督教迫害
title_en: Roman Emperor Galerius issues an Edict of Toleration on his deathbed, halting Christian persecution

title_zh: 米尔维安大桥战役：君士坦丁击败马克森提乌斯统一西部
title_en: Battle of the Milvian Bridge: Constantine defeats Maxentius, unifying the West

title_zh: 汉赵皇帝刘聪杀害被俘的晋怀帝司马炽
title_en: Han-Zhao Emperor Liu Cong kills the captured Emperor Huai of Jin

title_zh: 石勒进据襄国，建立稳固根据地
title_en: Shi Le occupies Xiangguo, establishing a solid base

title_zh: 罗马建成君士坦丁凯旋门
title_en: Rome completes the Arch of Constantine

title_zh: 君士坦丁与东部皇帝李锡尼在米兰会盟
title_en: Constantine meets Eastern Emperor Licinius in Milan

title_zh: 米兰协议：宗教宽容与基督教的合法地位
title_en: The Milan agreement: religious toleration and Christian legal status

title_zh: 祖逖率部曲北伐，收复黄河以南大片土地
title_en: Zu Ti leads his troops north on a punitive expedition, recovering vast lands south of the Yellow River

title_zh: 建康（建邺）开始作为东晋政治中心建设
title_en: Construction of Jiankang (Jianye) as the political center of the Eastern Jin begins

title_zh: 晋愍帝司马邺在长安被拥立为帝
title_en: Emperor Min of Jin Sima Ye is enthroned in Chang'an

title_zh: 前罗马皇帝马克西米安在高卢自杀身亡
title_en: Former Roman Emperor Maximian commits suicide in Gaul

title_zh: 张轨、张寔父子割据凉州，建立前凉政权雏形
title_en: Zhang Gui and Zhang Shi establish a base in Liangzhou, forming the prototype of Former Liang

title_zh: 石勒攻灭幽州王浚，吞并冀州广大地区
title_en: Shi Le attacks and destroys Wang Jun in Youzhou, annexing vast areas of Jizhou

title_zh: 小亚细亚教会会议讨论阿里乌斯派争端
title_en: Church council in Asia Minor discusses the Arian controversy

title_zh: 拓跋鲜卑首领拓跋猗卢建立代国
title_en: Tuoba Yilu, chieftain of the Tuoba Xianbei, establishes the Dai state

title_zh: 石勒攻灭青州曹嶷，统一黄河下游
title_en: Shi Le attacks and destroys Cao Yi in Qingzhou, unifying the lower Yellow River

title_zh: 北方士族大规模南渡，衣冠南迁
title_en: Large-scale southward migration of northern gentry: the 'Robes and Hats Southward Migration'

title_zh: 西晋灭亡：汉赵刘曜攻陷长安，晋愍帝投降
title_en: Fall of the Western Jin: Han-Zhao's Liu Yao captures Chang'an; Emperor Min surrenders

title_zh: 石勒开始建立后赵政权雏形
title_en: Shi Le begins to establish the prototype of the Later Zhao regime

title_zh: 祖逖谯城大捷，在东晋立足
title_en: Zu Ti's great victory at Qiaocheng establishes a foothold for the Eastern Jin

title_zh: 刘琨在并州孤军奋战，联合鲜卑对抗汉赵
title_en: Liu Kun fights alone in Bingzhou, allying with Xianbei against Han-Zhao

title_zh: 司马睿在建康称晋王，东晋建立
title_en: Sima Rui proclaims himself Prince of Jin at Jiankang, establishing the Eastern Jin

title_zh: 司马睿在建康正式即皇帝位，建立东晋
title_en: Sima Rui formally ascends the imperial throne at Jiankang, establishing the Eastern Jin

title_zh: 汉赵皇帝刘聪病逝，国内大乱
title_en: Han-Zhao Emperor Liu Cong dies, causing great internal chaos

title_zh: 刘曜迁都长安，建立前赵政权
title_en: Liu Yao moves the capital to Chang'an and establishes the Former Zhao regime

title_zh: 石勒在襄国称赵王，建立后赵政权
title_en: Shi Le proclaims himself King of Zhao at Xiangguo, establishing the Later Zhao regime

title_zh: 罗马帝国在君士坦丁堡设立法律教授职位
title_en: Professorships of law are established in Constantinople

title_zh: 前凉张茂继位，延续河西割据
title_en: Zhang Mao succeeds in Former Liang, continuing the Hexi separatist regime

title_zh: 蒂亚瓦纳科文化在南美安第斯高原兴起
title_en: Tiwanaku culture emerges in the Andean highlands of South America

title_zh: 旃陀罗笈多建立笈多王朝
title_en: Gupta Empire founded

title_zh: 笈多王朝兴起
title_en: Gupta Empire rises

title_zh: 笈多帝国建立，印度进入黄金时代
title_en: The Gupta Empire is founded, ushering in India's Golden Age

title_zh: 君士坦丁击败东部皇帝李锡尼，统一罗马帝国
title_en: Constantine defeats Eastern Emperor Licinius, reunifying the Roman Empire

title_zh: 王敦起兵攻入建康，开启东晋内战
title_en: Wang Dun raises his army and enters Jiankang, beginning civil war in the Eastern Jin

title_zh: 石勒在河北基本统一北方大部
title_en: Shi Le essentially unifies most of northern China in Hebei

title_zh: 君士坦丁立法规定星期日为礼拜日
title_en: Constantine legislates Sunday as a day of rest

title_zh: 祖逖北伐因朝廷猜忌而失败，忧愤而死
title_en: Zu Ti's northern expedition fails due to court suspicion; he dies of grief and anger

title_zh: 晋元帝司马睿因王敦之乱忧愤而死
title_en: Emperor Yuan of Jin dies of grief due to Wang Dun's rebellion

title_zh: 君士坦丁击败多瑙河哥特人，稳定北方边境
title_en: Constantine defeats the Danubian Goths, stabilizing the northern border

title_zh: 君士坦丁再次击败李锡尼残余势力，彻底统一
title_en: Constantine again defeats the remnants of Licinius, achieving complete unification

title_zh: 东晋朝廷平定王敦之乱
title_en: The Eastern Jin court puts down Wang Dun's rebellion

title_zh: 君士坦丁在拜占庭旧址建立新罗马
title_en: Constantine founds New Rome on the site of Byzantium

title_zh: 晋明帝司马绍病逝，晋成帝司马衍幼年即位
title_en: Emperor Ming of Jin dies; Emperor Cheng of Jin ascends as a child

title_zh: 第一次尼西亚大公会议召开，确立基督教基本教义
title_en: First Council of Nicaea convenes, establishing basic Christian doctrine

title_zh: 前赵刘曜攻打凉州前凉政权
title_en: Former Zhao's Liu Yao attacks the Former Liang regime in Liangzhou

title_zh: 庾亮专权激化东晋内部矛盾
title_en: Yu Liang's autocratic rule intensifies internal conflicts in the Eastern Jin

title_zh: 君士坦丁大帝处死长子克里斯普斯
title_en: Emperor Constantine the Great executes his eldest son Crispus

title_zh: 苏峻、祖约之乱：苏峻攻陷建康
title_en: Su Jun and Zu Yue rebellion: Su Jun captures Jiankang

title_zh: 石勒统一北方，后赵国力达到鼎盛
title_en: Shi Le unifies the north; Later Zhao reaches its peak

title_zh: 后赵石虎大败前赵刘曜，灭亡前赵
title_en: Later Zhao's Shi Hu defeats Former Zhao's Liu Yao, destroying Former Zhao

title_zh: 君士坦丁堡开始修建宏大城墙防御体系
title_en: Construction begins on the great defensive walls of Constantinople

title_zh: 陶侃、温峤平定苏峻之乱
title_en: Tao Kan and Wen Qiao put down the Su Jun rebellion

title_zh: 后赵石勒正式称帝，大封群臣
title_en: Later Zhao's Shi Le formally proclaims himself emperor and enfeoffs his ministers

title_zh: 君士坦丁大帝正式迁都君士坦丁堡
title_en: Emperor Constantine the Great formally moves the capital to Constantinople

title_zh: 君士坦丁堡大竞技场开始举办战车比赛
title_en: The Hippodrome of Constantinople begins hosting chariot races

title_zh: 君士坦丁堡正式落成启用
title_en: Constantinople is formally inaugurated

title_zh: 阿克苏姆皈依基督教
title_en: Aksum converts to Christianity

title_zh: 君士坦丁堡建成（新罗马）
title_en: Constantinople founded as Nova Roma

title_zh: 后赵石勒设立太学，推行儒学教育
title_en: Later Zhao's Shi Le establishes a Grand Academy, promoting Confucian education

title_zh: 东晋北伐祖逖旧部继续在淮北活动
title_en: Eastern Jin's northern expeditions: remnants of Zu Ti's forces continue activities in the Huai River region

title_zh: 君士坦丁皇帝发布鼓励基督教化法令
title_en: Emperor Constantine issues laws encouraging Christianization

title_zh: 名臣陶侃功高震主，晚年备受猜忌
title_en: The distinguished official Tao Kan, with great power, is increasingly suspected in his later years

title_zh: 萨珊波斯与罗马帝国在美索不达米亚边境冲突
title_en: Sasanian Persia and the Roman Empire clash in Mesopotamia

title_zh: 东晋名臣陶侃病逝
title_en: Eastern Jin minister Tao Kan dies

title_zh: 后赵开国皇帝石勒病逝，石虎夺权篡位
title_en: Later Zhao founding emperor Shi Le dies; Shi Hu usurps power

title_zh: 君士坦丁加强北方多瑙河防线
title_en: Constantine strengthens the Danubian frontier

title_zh: 石虎凶残统治后赵，残害宗室大臣
title_en: Shi Hu's tyrannical rule over Later Zhao; he massacres imperial clan members and ministers

title_zh: 成汉开国皇帝李雄病逝，成汉内乱开始
title_en: Cheng-Han founding emperor Li Xiong dies; internal strife begins in Cheng-Han

title_zh: 后赵石虎大建邺城宫室，劳民伤财
title_en: Later Zhao's Shi Hu massively constructs palaces in Yecheng, exhausting the people

title_zh: 圣墓教堂落成
title_en: Church of the Holy Sepulchre completed

title_zh: 君士坦丁大帝分封诸子为未来继承者
title_en: Constantine the Great partitions the empire among his sons as future heirs

title_zh: 阿里乌斯派基督教在东部帝国内的持续争议
title_en: Continued controversy over Arian Christianity within the Eastern Empire

title_zh: 东晋推行土断政策，整顿户籍
title_en: The Eastern Jin implements the 'Tuduan' policy, reorganizing household registration

title_zh: 慕容皝称燕王，建立前燕政权
title_en: Murong Huang proclaims himself King of Yan, establishing the Former Yan regime

title_zh: 阿克苏姆国王埃扎纳开始统治，王国强盛
title_en: King Ezana of Aksum begins his reign; the kingdom flourishes

title_zh: 罗马皇帝君士坦丁大帝病逝
title_en: Roman Emperor Constantine the Great dies

title_zh: 后赵石虎攻打前燕失败，损失惨重
title_en: Later Zhao's Shi Hu attacks Former Yan, suffers heavy losses

title_zh: 君士坦丁二世进攻其弟君士坦斯失败被杀
title_en: Constantine II attacks his brother Constans, is defeated and killed

title_zh: 拓跋什翼犍即代王位，重建代国
title_en: Tuoba Shiyijian ascends the throne of Dai, re-establishing the Dai state

title_zh: 庾亮北伐后赵失败
title_en: Yu Liang's northern expedition against Later Zhao fails

title_zh: 君士坦提乌斯二世被立为东部皇帝
title_en: Constantius II is proclaimed Eastern Emperor

title_zh: 东晋名相王导病逝
title_en: Eastern Jin Grand Chancellor Wang Dao dies

title_zh: 萨珊波斯帝国大规模迫害基督徒
title_en: The Sasanian Persian Empire begins a large-scale persecution of Christians

title_zh: 萨珊波斯艺术进入辉煌时期
title_en: Sasanian art reaches a golden age

title_zh: 东晋朝廷整顿侨置郡县
title_en: The Eastern Jin court reorganizes the Qiao commanderies and counties

title_zh: 哥特人乌尔菲拉主教推动哥特人基督教化
title_en: Gothic bishop Ulfilas promotes the Christianization of the Goths

title_zh: 君士坦提乌斯二世发动对波斯战争
title_en: Constantius II launches a war against Persia

title_zh: 晋成帝去世，晋康帝继位
title_en: Emperor Cheng of Jin dies; Emperor Kang of Jin succeeds

title_zh: 尼西亚信经在帝国东部再次确认权威
title_en: The Nicene Creed is reaffirmed as authoritative in the Eastern Empire

title_zh: 东晋庾翼积极准备北伐
title_en: Yu Yi of the Eastern Jin actively prepares for a northern expedition

title_zh: 晋康帝去世，幼子晋穆帝继位
title_en: Emperor Kang of Jin dies; his young son Emperor Mu of Jin succeeds

title_zh: 东晋与北方政权长期对峙于淮河一线
title_en: Long-term confrontation between the Eastern Jin and northern regimes along the Huai River line

title_zh: 桓温出任荆州刺史，掌握上游兵权
title_en: Huan Wen becomes Inspector of Jingzhou, gaining control of the upper Yangtze army

title_zh: 萨珊沙普尔二世攻占罗马美索不达米亚要塞
title_en: Shapur II of Sasanian Persia captures Roman fortresses in Mesopotamia

title_zh: 王羲之任会稽内史，书法艺术臻于巅峰
title_en: Wang Xizhi serves as Grand Administrator of Kuaiji, his calligraphy reaches its peak

title_zh: 罗马帝国调整东方防御体系，应对波斯威胁
title_en: The Roman Empire reorganizes its eastern defensive system to counter the Persian threat

title_zh: 桓温伐蜀，灭亡成汉政权
title_en: Huan Wen attacks Shu, destroying the Cheng-Han regime

title_zh: 东晋完全控制巴蜀，设立益州
title_en: The Eastern Jin fully controls Bashu, establishing Yizhou

title_zh: 前秦苻洪率氐族部众迁徙关中
title_en: Pu Hong, chieftain of the Di tribe, leads his people to migrate to Guanzhong

title_zh: 笈多帝国时期印度教与佛教并荣发展
title_en: Hinduism and Buddhism flourish together in the Gupta Empire

title_zh: 前燕慕容皝去世，慕容儁继位
title_en: Murong Huang of Former Yan dies; Murong Jun succeeds

title_zh: 罗马帝国大量招募日耳曼雇佣军充实边防
title_en: The Roman Empire recruits large numbers of Germanic mercenaries to strengthen border defenses

title_zh: 后赵暴君石虎去世，诸子争位内乱爆发
title_en: Later Zhao tyrant Shi Hu dies; succession struggle and internal chaos erupt

title_zh: 冉闵在后赵内乱中崭露头角，掌握兵权
title_en: Ran Min emerges during the Later Zhao civil war, gaining military control

title_zh: 冉闵杀胡称帝，建立冉魏政权
title_en: Ran Min issues the 'Kill the Barbarians' order and proclaims himself emperor, establishing the Ran Wei regime

title_zh: 阿克苏姆灭麦罗埃
title_en: Aksum conquers Meroë

title_zh: 马格嫩提乌斯在西罗马称帝
title_en: Magnentius proclaims himself emperor in the Western Roman Empire

title_zh: 玛雅文明完善其复杂的历法系统
title_en: The Maya civilization perfects its complex calendrical system

title_zh: 无著开创瑜伽行派
title_en: Asanga founds Yogacara

title_zh: 苻健建立前秦政权，定都长安
title_en: Pu Jian establishes the Former Qin regime, making Chang'an its capital

title_zh: 笈多帝国统一北印度大部分地区
title_en: The Gupta Empire unifies most of northern India

title_zh: 冉闵与慕容儁交战，冉魏实力大损
title_en: Ran Min engages Murong Jun in battle; Ran Wei's strength is severely depleted

title_zh: 东罗马皇帝君士坦提乌斯二世击败僭帝马格嫩提乌斯
title_en: Eastern Roman Emperor Constantius II defeats the usurper Magnentius

title_zh: 前秦苻健正式称帝
title_en: Former Qin's Pu Jian formally proclaims himself emperor

title_zh: 前燕慕容儁消灭冉魏，统一河北
title_en: Former Yan's Murong Jun destroys Ran Wei, unifying Hebei

title_zh: 君士坦提乌斯二世任命堂弟尤里安为西部副帝（凯撒）
title_en: Constantius II appoints his cousin Julian as Western Caesar

title_zh: 兰亭雅集：王羲之创作《兰亭集序》
title_en: Lanting Gathering: Wang Xizhi creates the 'Preface to the Lanting Collection'

title_zh: 君士坦提乌斯二世成为罗马帝国唯一皇帝
title_en: Constantius II becomes the sole emperor of the Roman Empire

title_zh: 桓温第一次北伐前秦，兵锋直抵灞上
title_en: Huan Wen's first northern expedition against Former Qin reaches the Ba River

title_zh: 西部凯撒尤里安在高卢抵抗日耳曼入侵
title_en: Western Caesar Julian resists Germanic invasions in Gaul

title_zh: 前秦开国皇帝苻健去世，暴君苻生继位
title_en: Former Qin founding emperor Pu Jian dies; the tyrant Fu Sheng succeeds

title_zh: 阿勒曼尼人大规模入侵高卢，尤里安迎战
title_en: The Alemanni invade Gaul on a large scale; Julian responds

title_zh: 东晋桓温第二次北伐，收复洛阳
title_en: Huan Wen's second northern expedition recovers Luoyang

title_zh: 斯特拉斯堡战役：尤里安大败阿勒曼尼人
title_en: Battle of Strasbourg: Julian decisively defeats the Alemanni

title_zh: 苻坚杀苻生，自立为前秦皇帝，王猛辅政
title_en: Fu Jian kills Fu Sheng, proclaims himself emperor of Former Qin, with Wang Meng as chief minister

title_zh: 王猛出任前秦中书令，推行法制改革
title_en: Wang Meng is appointed Palace Attendant and Head of the Secretariat in Former Qin, promoting legal reforms

title_zh: 尤里安在高卢重建城市，恢复秩序
title_en: Julian rebuilds cities and restores order in Gaul

title_zh: 尤里安被皇帝召回高卢，驻节巴黎应对蛮族
title_en: Julian is recalled by the emperor to Gaul, stationed in Paris to face the barbarians

title_zh: 王猛主持前秦吏治改革，罢免庸官数百
title_en: Wang Meng directs civil service reform in Former Qin, dismissing hundreds of incompetent officials

title_zh: 前燕向南扩张，攻占东晋淮北领土
title_en: Former Yan expands south, capturing Eastern Jin territories north of the Huai River

title_zh: 萨珊波斯围攻克罗马要塞阿米达
title_en: Sasanian Persia besieges and captures the Roman fortress of Amida

title_zh: 前燕慕容儁去世，慕容暐幼年继位，慕容恪辅政
title_en: Former Yan's Murong Jun dies; the young Murong Wei succeeds, with Murong Ke as regent

title_zh: 尤里安在高卢被军队拥立为帝，内战爆发
title_en: Julian is proclaimed emperor by his troops in Gaul, civil war erupts

title_zh: 东晋晋穆帝去世，晋哀帝司马丕继位
title_en: Emperor Mu of Jin dies; Emperor Ai of Jin ascends

title_zh: 罗马皇帝君士坦提乌斯二世病逝，尤里安成为唯一皇帝
title_en: Roman Emperor Constantius II dies; Julian becomes sole emperor

title_zh: 东晋与北方前燕对峙于淮北一线
title_en: Eastern Jin and Former Yan confront each other along the Huai River line

title_zh: 罗马皇帝尤里安发起多神教复兴运动，压制基督教
title_en: Roman Emperor Julian launches a pagan revival movement, suppressing Christianity

title_zh: 东晋晋哀帝去世，晋废帝司马奕继位
title_en: Emperor Ai of Jin dies; Emperor Fei of Jin ascends

title_zh: 桓温专权，废除晋废帝意图昭然若揭
title_en: Huan Wen monopolizes power, openly intends to depose Emperor Fei of Jin

title_zh: 罗马皇帝尤里安远征波斯，战死沙场
title_en: Roman Emperor Julian campaigns against Persia and is killed in battle

title_zh: 桓温推行“庚戌土断”，清理侨户
title_en: Huan Wen implements the 'Gengxu Tuduan,' reorganizing the refugee household registration

title_zh: 地中海克里特大地震海啸
title_en: Crete earthquake and tsunami

title_zh: 罗马新皇帝约维安与波斯签订和约，割让边境领土
title_en: New Roman Emperor Jovian makes peace with Persia, ceding border territories

title_zh: 前燕攻占洛阳，东晋北伐成果丧失
title_en: Former Yan captures Luoyang, nullifying Eastern Jin's northern gains

title_zh: 瓦伦斯被任命为罗马东部皇帝
title_en: Valens is appointed Eastern Roman Emperor

title_zh: 敦煌莫高窟开始开凿
title_en: Excavation of the Mogao Caves at Dunhuang begins

title_zh: 前秦苻坚同母弟苻双等发动叛乱
title_en: Fu Shuang and others, brothers of Former Qin's Fu Jian, launch a rebellion

title_zh: 西部皇帝瓦伦提尼安一世在西方稳定边防
title_en: Western Emperor Valentinian I stabilizes the frontier in the West

title_zh: 皮克特人和苏格兰人联合入侵罗马不列颠
title_en: Picts and Scots jointly invade Roman Britain

title_zh: 王猛改革全面推行，前秦法制建设取得成效
title_en: Wang Meng's reforms are fully implemented; legal construction in Former Qin bears fruit

title_zh: 桓温第三次北伐：枋头惨败
title_en: Huan Wen's third northern expedition: crushing defeat at Fangtou

title_zh: 前燕大将慕容垂遭猜忌，被迫投奔前秦
title_en: Former Yan general Murong Chui is suspected and forced to defect to Former Qin

title_zh: 罗马帝国收复不列颠，平定蛮族叛乱
title_en: The Roman Empire recovers Britain, suppressing barbarian revolts

title_zh: 前秦灭亡前燕，统一中国北方
title_en: Former Qin destroys Former Yan, unifying northern China

title_zh: 匈奴残部西迁进入东欧大草原
title_en: Remnant Xiongnu tribes migrate westward to the East European steppe

title_zh: 耶路撒冷罗马神庙事件：犹太教与基督教冲突
title_en: The Roman Temple incident in Jerusalem: conflict between Jews and Christians

title_zh: 罗马帝国与萨珊波斯争夺亚美尼亚控制权
title_en: The Roman Empire and Sasanian Persia vie for control of Armenia

title_zh: 桓温废黜晋废帝司马奕，改立晋简文帝司马昱
title_en: Huan Wen deposes Emperor Fei of Jin and establishes Emperor Jianwen of Jin

title_zh: 佛教传入高句丽：王权需要一套新语言
title_en: Buddhism enters Goguryeo: a new language for royal power

title_zh: 晋简文帝去世，晋孝武帝司马曜继位，谢安出山辅政
title_en: Emperor Jianwen of Jin dies; Emperor Xiaowu ascends; Xie An comes to court as regent

title_zh: 前秦苻坚加强对西域的控制，丝路畅通
title_en: Former Qin's Fu Jian strengthens control over the Western Regions, opening the Silk Road

title_zh: 罗马东部皇帝瓦伦斯迫害正统派基督徒
title_en: Eastern Roman Emperor Valens persecutes orthodox Christians

title_zh: 东晋桓温病逝，桓冲主动让权，谢安成为支柱
title_en: Huan Wen of the Eastern Jin dies; Huan Chong voluntarily yields power; Xie An becomes the pillar

title_zh: 谢安东山再起，正式执掌东晋朝政
title_en: Xie An returns from seclusion and formally takes charge of the Eastern Jin government

title_zh: 西部皇帝瓦伦提尼安一世去世，格拉提安继位
title_en: Western Emperor Valentinian I dies; Gratian succeeds

title_zh: 前秦丞相王猛病逝，苻坚失去栋梁
title_en: Former Qin Grand Chancellor Wang Meng dies; Fu Jian loses his pillar

title_zh: 嚈哒人（白匈奴）开始进入中亚，威胁萨珊波斯
title_en: The Hephthalites (White Huns) begin entering Central Asia, threatening the Sasanian Empire

title_zh: 笈多文化黄金时代
title_en: Gupta golden age

title_zh: 萨珊波斯沙普尔二世去世
title_en: Shapur II of Sasanian Persia dies

title_zh: 西哥特人遭匈人驱赶，请求进入罗马帝国避难
title_en: The Visigoths, driven by the Huns, request to enter the Roman Empire for refuge

title_zh: 前秦攻灭前凉，统一北方最后一块地区
title_en: Former Qin destroys Former Liang, unifying the last region of the north

title_zh: 东晋谢玄组建北府兵，训练精兵
title_en: Xie Xuan of the Eastern Jin forms the 'Beifu Army', training elite troops

title_zh: 罗马帝国收容的西哥特人在色雷斯暴动
title_en: The Visigoths received into the Roman Empire revolt in Thrace

title_zh: 前秦苻坚积极准备南征东晋
title_en: Fu Jian of Former Qin actively prepares to attack the Eastern Jin

title_zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎影响扩散至玛雅地区
title_en: Teotihuacan influence extends into the Maya region

title_zh: 前秦攻占东晋重镇襄阳，打开南方门户
title_en: Former Qin captures the Eastern Jin stronghold Xiangyang, opening the gateway to the south

title_zh: 蒂卡尔崛起
title_en: Tikal's hegemony

title_zh: 狄奥多西被任命为罗马东部皇帝，开始复兴
title_en: Theodosius is appointed Eastern Roman Emperor, beginning the restoration

title_zh: 阿德里安堡战役：西哥特骑兵大败罗马军团，瓦伦斯战死
title_en: Battle of Adrianople: Visigothic cavalry routs the Roman army; Valens is killed

title_zh: 前秦继续向南推进，东晋形势危急
title_en: Former Qin continues its southern advance; the Eastern Jin situation becomes critical

title_zh: 东罗马皇帝狄奥多西一世稳定局势，与哥特人停战
title_en: Eastern Roman Emperor Theodosius I stabilizes the situation, concluding a truce with the Goths

title_zh: 《阿他那修信经》确立三位一体教义
title_en: The Athanasian Creed affirms the Trinity

title_zh: 笈多帝国萨穆陀罗笈多南征，征服德干高原诸国
title_en: Samudragupta of the Gupta Empire campaigns south, conquering the kingdoms of the Deccan

title_zh: 狄奥多西颁布“塞萨洛尼基敕令”，基督教成为罗马帝国国教
title_en: Theodosius issues the Edict of Thessalonica, making Christianity the state religion of the Roman Empire
