title_zh: 北府兵初显锋芒，在东晋边境屡败前秦侦察部队
title_en: The Beifu Army shows its prowess, repeatedly defeating Former Qin reconnaissance forces along the border

title_zh: 印度教在笈多帝国支持下迎来复兴浪潮
title_en: Hinduism experiences a revival under the patronage of the Gupta Empire

title_zh: 君士坦丁堡大公会议召开，确认尼西亚信经
title_en: The First Council of Constantinople convenes, reaffirming the Nicene Creed

title_zh: 苻坚不顾反对，全面备战南征东晋
title_en: Fu Jian, ignoring opposition, fully prepares for a southern campaign against the Eastern Jin

title_zh: 谢安镇定自若，从容部署东晋防线
title_en: Xie An, unflappable, calmly deploys the Eastern Jin defense line

title_zh: 罗马帝国与西哥特人缔结和约，狄奥多西用蛮族制蛮族
title_en: The Roman Empire concludes a peace treaty with the Visigoths; Theodosius uses barbarians to fight barbarians

title_zh: 前秦大军集结完毕，苻坚誓师南征
title_en: The Former Qin army is fully assembled; Fu Jian vows to march south

title_zh: 罗马西部皇帝格拉提安被刺杀，帝国陷入内乱
title_en: Western Roman Emperor Gratian is assassinated; the empire is thrown into turmoil

title_zh: 淝水之战：东晋大败前秦，苻坚统一梦想破灭
title_en: Battle of Fei River: The Eastern Jin decisively defeats Former Qin, shattering Fu Jian's dream of unification

title_zh: 谢安接捷报时镇定如常，心中狂喜而不露声色
title_en: Xie An remains composed upon receiving the victory report, though inwardly overjoyed

title_zh: 慕容垂叛离前秦，建立后燕政权
title_en: Murong Chui rebels against Former Qin and establishes the Later Yan regime

title_zh: 麦积山石窟开凿
title_en: Maijishan Grottoes carved

title_zh: 僧肇著《肇论》
title_en: Sengzhao writes the Zhao Lun

title_zh: 罗马西部僭帝马克西穆斯正式称帝
title_en: Western Roman usurper Maximus formally proclaims himself emperor

title_zh: 乞伏国仁建立西秦政权
title_en: Qifu Guoren establishes the Western Qin regime

title_zh: 拓跋珪在牛川重建代国，北魏雏形出现
title_en: Tuoba Gui re-establishes the Dai state at Niuchuan, the prototype of Northern Wei

title_zh: 姚苌缢杀苻坚，前秦皇帝身亡
title_en: Yao Chang strangles Fu Jian; the Former Qin emperor dies

title_zh: 狄奥多西一世进一步加强东正教地位
title_en: Theodosius I further strengthens the position of Orthodox Christianity

title_zh: 拓跋珪改称魏王，奠定北魏国号
title_en: Tuoba Gui changes his title to King of Wei, establishing the Northern Wei state name

title_zh: 吕光从西域返回，建立后凉政权
title_en: Lü Guang returns from the Western Regions and establishes the Later Liang regime

title_zh: 后燕慕容垂巩固北方，吞并河北大部
title_en: Murong Chui of Later Yan consolidates the north, annexing most of Hebei

title_zh: 东部皇帝狄奥多西一世击败西部僭主马克西穆斯
title_en: Eastern Emperor Theodosius I defeats the Western usurper Maximus

title_zh: 罗马帝国在狄奥多西一世统治下短暂统一
title_en: The Roman Empire is briefly unified under Theodosius I

title_zh: 后凉吕光正式称王
title_en: Lü Guang of Later Liang formally proclaims himself king

title_zh: 亚历山大城塞拉皮斯神庙被基督徒摧毁
title_en: The Serapeum of Alexandria is destroyed by Christians

title_zh: 北魏拓跋珪大破匈奴铁弗部，统一代北
title_en: Northern Wei's Tuoba Gui defeats the Xiongnu Tiefu tribe, unifying the Daibei region

title_zh: 帖撒罗尼迦屠杀：罗马军队镇压平民暴动
title_en: Thessalonica massacre: Roman army suppresses a civilian revolt

title_zh: 东晋会稽王司马道子专权，朝政混乱
title_en: The Prince of Kuaiji, Sima Daozi, monopolizes power in the Eastern Jin, leading to political chaos

title_zh: 狄奥多西一世全面禁止异教活动
title_en: Theodosius I completely bans pagan activities

title_zh: 北魏大破铁弗匈奴残部，彻底控制河套
title_en: Northern Wei defeats the remnants of the Tiefu Xiongnu, completely controlling the Hetao region

title_zh: 后秦姚兴继位，整顿内政
title_en: Yao Xing of Later Qin succeeds and reorganizes internal affairs

title_zh: 西部僭主尤金尼乌斯在西部称帝，挑战狄奥多西
title_en: Western usurper Eugenius proclaims himself emperor in the West, challenging Theodosius

title_zh: 后燕慕容垂灭翟魏，扩大领土
title_en: Murong Chui of Later Yan destroys the Zhai Wei, expanding his territory

title_zh: 狄奥多西一世举行最后一次古代奥林匹克运动会
title_en: Theodosius I holds the last ancient Olympic Games

title_zh: 后燕慕容垂灭亡西燕，统一关东
title_en: Murong Chui of Later Yan destroys Western Yan, unifying the eastern part of the passes

title_zh: 冷河战役：狄奥多西一世击败尤金尼乌斯，最后统一罗马
title_en: Battle of the Frigidus: Theodosius I defeats Eugenius, finally reuniting Rome

title_zh: 后凉吕光杀大臣，统治日趋暴虐
title_en: Lü Guang of Later Liang kills officials; his rule becomes increasingly tyrannical

title_zh: 后秦姚兴攻占东晋洛阳
title_en: Yao Xing of Later Qin captures Luoyang from the Eastern Jin

title_zh: 西哥特领袖阿拉里克入侵希腊半岛
title_en: Visigothic leader Alaric invades the Greek peninsula

title_zh: 后燕参合陂之战惨败于北魏，慕容垂精锐尽失
title_en: Later Yan suffers a devastating defeat at the Battle of Canhe Slope by Northern Wei, losing its elite forces

title_zh: 罗马帝国永久分裂为东西两部分
title_en: The Roman Empire permanently splits into Eastern and Western halves

title_zh: 东晋晋孝武帝被张贵人杀死，司马道子兄弟擅权
title_en: Emperor Xiaowu of Jin is killed by his concubine Lady Zhang; Sima Daozi and his brother usurp power

title_zh: 西罗马权臣斯提利科击败西哥特人阿拉里克
title_en: Western Roman general Stilicho defeats the Visigoth Alaric

title_zh: 北魏拓跋珪正式称帝，建立北魏王朝
title_en: Tuoba Gui of Northern Wei formally proclaims himself emperor, establishing the Northern Wei dynasty

title_zh: 后燕开国皇帝慕容垂病逝，后燕国势衰微
title_en: Murong Chui, founding emperor of Later Yan, dies; Later Yan's power declines

title_zh: 斯提利科远征北非，镇压当地叛乱
title_en: Stilicho campaigns in North Africa, suppressing a local rebellion

title_zh: 段业建立北凉政权
title_en: Duan Ye establishes the Northern Liang regime

title_zh: 秃发乌孤建立南凉政权
title_en: Tufa Wugu establishes the Southern Liang regime

title_zh: 君士坦丁堡牧首约翰·克里索斯托开始领导教会
title_en: John Chrysostom, Patriarch of Constantinople, begins to lead the church

title_zh: 北魏正式迁都平城，营造宫殿
title_en: Northern Wei formally moves its capital to Pingcheng, building palaces

title_zh: 孙恩起义爆发，东晋东南大乱
title_en: The Sun En rebellion breaks out, causing great chaos in the southeastern Eastern Jin

title_zh: 慕容德建立南燕政权
title_en: Murong De establishes the Southern Yan regime

title_zh: 法显西行求法
title_en: Faxian's pilgrimage west

title_zh: 西域高僧鸠摩罗什被后秦迎至长安译经
title_en: The Western Regions monk Kumarajiva is welcomed to Chang'an by Later Qin to translate scriptures

title_zh: 法显从长安出发西行求法，前往印度
title_en: Faxian departs from Chang'an for the west in search of Buddhist scriptures, heading to India

title_zh: 孙恩起义军攻占会稽，逼近建康
title_en: The Sun En rebel army captures Kuaiji and approaches Jiankang

title_zh: 北非多纳图派分裂运动严重
title_en: The Donatist schism in North Africa becomes severe

title_zh: 奥古斯丁完成《忏悔录》
title_en: Augustine completes the Confessions

title_zh: 李暠建立西凉政权
title_en: Li Gao establishes the Western Liang regime

title_zh: 东罗马帝国爆发盖纳斯叛乱，蛮族将领作乱
title_en: The Gainas rebellion breaks out in the Eastern Roman Empire; a barbarian general rebels

title_zh: 顾恺之绘《女史箴图》
title_en: Gu Kaizhi paints Admonitions Scroll

title_zh: 复活节岛开始雕刻巨型石像（摩艾）
title_en: Easter Island begins carving giant stone statues (Moai)

title_zh: 东晋将领刘裕在孙恩之战中崭露头角
title_en: Eastern Jin general Liu Yu distinguishes himself in the Sun En rebellion

title_zh: 鸠摩罗什在长安组织大规模译经，大乘佛教系统传入中原
title_en: Kumarajiva organizes large-scale translation of scriptures in Chang'an, systematically introducing Mahayana Buddhism into central China

title_zh: 南凉秃发利鹿孤称王，改元建和
title_en: Tufa Lilugong of Southern Liang proclaims himself king, changes era name to Jianhe

title_zh: 西哥特王阿拉里克首次入侵意大利北部
title_en: Visigothic King Alaric I invades northern Italy for the first time

title_zh: 陶渊明辞官归隐，开创田园诗派
title_en: Tao Yuanming resigns from office and retires to countryside, founding the pastoral poetry school

title_zh: 玛雅城邦帕伦克进入快速发展期
title_en: Maya city-state of Palenque enters a period of rapid development

title_zh: 罗马统帅斯提利科在波伦提亚战役击败阿拉里克
title_en: Roman general Stilicho defeats Alaric at the Battle of Pollentia

title_zh: 西罗马帝国正式迁都拉文纳
title_en: Western Roman Empire formally moves capital to Ravenna

title_zh: 基督教修道制度在罗马帝国东部蓬勃发展
title_en: Christian monasticism flourishes in the eastern Roman Empire

title_zh: 桓玄攻入建康，总揽朝政
title_en: Huan Xuan enters Jiankang and takes control of the court

title_zh: 西哥特国王阿拉里克颁布《西哥特罗马法典》
title_en: Visigothic King Alaric I issues the Breviary of Alaric

title_zh: 孙恩起义失败，投海自尽
title_en: Sun En's rebellion fails, he drowns himself

title_zh: 桓玄逼迫晋安帝禅让，建立桓楚政权
title_en: Huan Xuan forces Emperor An of Jin to abdicate, establishes Huan Chu regime

title_zh: 法显抵达天竺，在佛教圣地进行巡礼
title_en: Faxian arrives in India, makes pilgrimage to Buddhist holy sites

title_zh: 罗马统帅斯提利科在维罗纳再次击败阿拉里克
title_en: Roman general Stilicho defeats Alaric again at Verona

title_zh: 匈奴王乌尔丁率军入侵东罗马色雷斯
title_en: Hun king Uldin leads invasion of Eastern Roman Thrace

title_zh: 鸠摩罗什译出《大智度论》
title_en: Kumarajiva translates the Great Perfection of Wisdom Treatise

title_zh: 刘裕在京口起兵，讨伐桓玄
title_en: Liu Yu raises troops at Jingkou to attack Huan Xuan

title_zh: 桓玄在江陵兵败被杀
title_en: Huan Xuan defeated and killed at Jiangling

title_zh: 北魏皇帝拓跋珪推行离散诸部政策
title_en: Emperor Daowu of Northern Wei implements policy of scattering tribes

title_zh: 法显从印度坐船启程归国
title_en: Faxian sets sail from India to return home

title_zh: 谯纵在蜀地割据，自称成都王
title_en: Qiao Zong secedes in Shu, proclaims himself King of Chengdu

title_zh: 耶柔米完成《武加大译本》
title_en: Jerome completes the Vulgate Bible

title_zh: 晋安帝复位，刘裕掌控东晋朝政
title_en: Emperor An of Jin restored; Liu Yu controls Eastern Jin government

title_zh: 不列颠驻军推举君士坦丁三世为帝
title_en: Roman troops in Britain proclaim Constantine III emperor

title_zh: 汪达尔、苏维汇和阿兰人越过莱茵河，入侵高卢
title_en: Vandals, Suebi, and Alans cross the Rhine, invade Gaul

title_zh: 刘裕实行土断，整顿户籍与赋税
title_en: Liu Yu implements Tunduan, reorganizes household registration and taxes

title_zh: 北凉君主沮渠蒙逊攻陷敦煌
title_en: Northern Liang ruler Juqu Mengxun captures Dunhuang

title_zh: 赫连勃勃自称大夏天王，建立大夏政权
title_en: Helian Bobo proclaims himself Heavenly King of Xia, establishes the Xia regime

title_zh: 刘裕遣使到后秦索取十二音律乐器
title_en: Liu Yu sends envoy to Later Qin to request twelve-tone pitch pipes

title_zh: 西罗马皇帝霍诺里乌斯下令从大不列颠撤军
title_en: Western Roman Emperor Honorius orders withdrawal from Britain

title_zh: 刘裕开始筹划北伐南燕，整军备战
title_en: Liu Yu begins planning northern expedition against Southern Yan, prepares army

title_zh: 西罗马皇帝霍诺里乌斯处死统帅斯提利科
title_en: Western Roman Emperor Honorius executes general Stilicho

title_zh: 法显抵达狮子国并停留两年学习佛法
title_en: Faxian arrives in Sri Lanka and stays two years to study Buddhism

title_zh: 刘裕率军北伐南燕，进抵琅琊
title_en: Liu Yu leads northern expedition against Southern Yan, reaches Langya

title_zh: 汪达尔人、阿兰人和苏维汇人从高卢进入西班牙
title_en: Vandals, Alans, and Suebi cross from Gaul into Spain

title_zh: 东晋荆州刺史刘毅吞并江州，与刘裕矛盾激化
title_en: Eastern Jin Inspector of Jingzhou Liu Yi annexes Jiangzhou, intensifying conflict with Liu Yu

title_zh: 卢循、徐道覆率起义军北上，逼近建康
title_en: Lu Xun and Xu Daofu lead rebel forces northward, approaching Jiankang

title_zh: 法显从狮子国乘船东归，到达耶婆提国
title_en: Faxian leaves Sri Lanka by ship, reaches Yavadvipa

title_zh: 阿拉里克劫掠罗马：象征性重击，不是帝国终点
title_en: Alaric sacks Rome: a symbolic blow, not the end of the empire

title_zh: 刘裕攻克广固，灭亡南燕
title_en: Liu Yu captures Guanggu, destroys Southern Yan

title_zh: 西哥特人阿陶尔夫继位，率军退往高卢南部
title_en: Visigothic king Athaulf succeeds Alaric, leads forces to southern Gaul

title_zh: 卢循在广州被晋军剿灭，投水自尽
title_en: Lu Xun is defeated and drowns himself in Guangzhou

title_zh: 刘裕在建康城外击败卢循，收复江州
title_en: Liu Yu defeats Lu Xun outside Jiankang, recovers Jiangzhou

title_zh: 法显携带大量佛经从海路返回中国
title_en: Faxian returns to China by sea with many Buddhist scriptures

title_zh: 刘裕诱杀刘毅，铲除政敌
title_en: Liu Yu tricks and kills Liu Yi, eliminating a political rival

title_zh: 女哲学家希帕提娅在亚历山大城被暴徒杀害
title_en: Female philosopher Hypatia murdered by a mob in Alexandria

title_zh: 赫连勃勃开始修筑统万城
title_en: Helian Bobo begins construction of Tongwan City

title_zh: 顾恺之绘《洛神赋图》
title_en: Gu Kaizhi paints the Nymph of the Luo River

title_zh: 狄奥多西城墙：把君士坦丁堡围成要塞
title_en: The Theodosian Walls turn Constantinople into a fortress

title_zh: 西哥特王国与西罗马帝国签订正式同盟条约
title_en: Visigothic Kingdom and Western Roman Empire sign formal treaty of alliance

title_zh: 刘裕命朱龄石平定蜀地，消灭谯纵
title_en: Liu Yu orders Zhu Lingshi to pacify Sichuan, destroying Qiao Zong

title_zh: 西哥特国王瓦利亚大败汪达尔人和阿兰人
title_en: Visigothic king Wallia decisively defeats Vandals and Alans

title_zh: 后秦皇帝姚兴大举进攻大夏，兵败退回
title_en: Later Qin emperor Yao Xing attacks Xia, is defeated and retreats

title_zh: 法显抵达建康，在道场寺翻译佛经
title_en: Faxian arrives in Jiankang, translates Buddhist scriptures at Daochang Temple

title_zh: 希帕蒂娅在亚历山大遇害
title_en: Hypatia is killed in Alexandria

title_zh: 西哥特国王瓦利亚大败汪达尔国王贡德里克
title_en: Visigothic king Wallia decisively defeats Vandal king Gunderic

title_zh: 刘裕讨伐司马休之，彻底清除反对势力
title_en: Liu Yu attacks Sima Xiuzhi, eliminates last opposition

title_zh: 北凉沮渠蒙逊攻陷酒泉，消灭西凉
title_en: Northern Liang's Juqu Mengxun captures Jiuquan, destroys Western Liang

title_zh: 西哥特国王瓦利亚去世，提奥多里克一世继位
title_en: Visigothic king Wallia dies; Theodoric I succeeds

title_zh: 后秦皇帝姚兴去世，诸子内讧
title_en: Later Qin emperor Yao Xing dies; sons fall into internal strife

title_zh: 刘裕大举北伐后秦，分兵五路
title_en: Liu Yu launches massive expedition against Later Qin, dividing into five routes

title_zh: 刘裕因建康政变传闻被迫南返，丢失关中
title_en: Liu Yu forced to return south due to rumors of coup in Jiankang, loses Guanzhong

title_zh: 刘裕受封宋公，加九锡
title_en: Liu Yu enfeoffed as Duke of Song, granted nine bestowments

title_zh: 刘裕北伐军攻克长安，灭亡后秦
title_en: Liu Yu's expeditionary force captures Chang'an, destroys Later Qin

title_zh: 萨珊波斯国王巴赫拉姆五世即位
title_en: Bahram V becomes king of the Sassanian Empire

title_zh: 大夏王赫连勃勃攻占长安，称帝
title_en: Xia king Helian Bobo captures Chang'an, proclaims himself emperor

title_zh: 刘裕派使者赴后秦和凉州索求经典和乐器
title_en: Liu Yu sends envoys to Later Qin remnants and Liangzhou to request classics and musical instruments

title_zh: 刘裕派中书侍郎王韶之缢杀晋安帝，立司马德文
title_en: Liu Yu sends Wang Shaozhi to strangle Emperor An of Jin, places Sima Dewen on throne

title_zh: 汪达尔王国国王盖萨里克与西罗马帝国签订和约
title_en: Vandal king Gaiseric signs treaty with Western Roman Empire

title_zh: 佛经《大般涅槃经》开始在北凉翻译
title_en: Translation of the Mahaparinirvana Sutra begins in Northern Liang

title_zh: 印度数学家发明零的符号和十进制计数法
title_en: Indian mathematicians invent the symbol for zero and decimal place-value system

title_zh: 刘裕实行土断与度田，抑制豪强
title_en: Liu Yu implements Tunduan and Dudian, curbs powerful clans

title_zh: 刘裕接受晋恭帝禅让，建立南朝宋
title_en: Liu Yu accepts abdication from Emperor Gong of Jin, establishes Liu Song dynasty

title_zh: 云锦织造始于南朝
title_en: Yunjin brocade begins in the Southern Dynasties

title_zh: 南北朝对峙
title_en: The Northern and Southern Dynasties divide China

title_zh: 西罗马帝国驻不列颠最后一支军队撤离
title_en: Last Roman legion in Britain withdraws

title_zh: 威尼斯建城
title_en: Venice founded

title_zh: 刘裕杀害晋恭帝，彻底断绝东晋复辟可能
title_en: Liu Yu kills Emperor Gong of Jin, ends any possibility of Jin restoration

title_zh: 刘宋北伐军消灭北凉在河西的残部，收复部分失地
title_en: Liu Song expeditionary force eliminates Northern Liang remnants in Hexi, recovers some territory

title_zh: 刘宋与北魏在黄河沿线发生大规模冲突
title_en: Large-scale conflict between Liu Song and Northern Wei along the Yellow River

title_zh: 北魏明元帝拓跋嗣去世，太武帝拓跋焘继位
title_en: Emperor Mingyuan of Northern Wei dies; Emperor Taiwu ascends

title_zh: 宋武帝刘裕病逝，宋少帝刘义符继位
title_en: Emperor Wu of Song dies; Emperor Shao of Song ascends

title_zh: 北魏攻克虎牢关，刘宋北方防线崩溃
title_en: Northern Wei captures Hulao Pass; Liu Song northern defenses collapse

title_zh: 匈奴王阿提拉和布莱达共同继承王位
title_en: Hun kings Attila and Bleda jointly succeed to the throne

title_zh: 徐羡之等废黜宋少帝，迎立宋文帝
title_en: Xu Xianzhi etc. depose Emperor Shao of Song, install Emperor Wen of Song

title_zh: 北魏太武帝亲征柔然，大破敕勒
title_en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei personally campaigns against Rouran, defeats Chile

title_zh: 东罗马帝国与萨珊波斯爆发边境战争
title_en: Eastern Roman Empire and Sassanian Persia engage in border war

title_zh: 宋文帝诛杀徐羡之、傅亮，铲除辅政大臣
title_en: Emperor Wen of Song executes Xu Xianzhi and Fu Liang, eliminates the regents

title_zh: 宋文帝提倡儒学，开办四学馆
title_en: Emperor Wen of Song promotes Confucianism, establishes four academies

title_zh: 汪达尔王国国王盖萨里克大规模建设海军
title_en: Vandal king Gaiseric builds a large navy

title_zh: 君士坦丁堡狄奥多西城墙全面竣工
title_en: Theodosian Walls of Constantinople completed

title_zh: 聂斯托利派基督教争论激化，引发宗教冲突
title_en: Nestorian Christian controversy intensifies, leading to religious conflict

title_zh: 北魏太武帝攻占长安，大夏势力退出关中
title_en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei captures Chang'an, Xia forces withdraw from Guanzhong

title_zh: 陶渊明病逝
title_en: Tao Yuanming dies of illness

title_zh: 北凉沮渠蒙逊遣使向刘宋朝贡
title_en: Juqu Mengxun of Northern Liang sends envoys to pay tribute to Liu Song

title_zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克率军占领迦太基
title_en: Vandal king Gaiseric captures Carthage

title_zh: 北魏攻克统万城，大夏主力被歼
title_en: Northern Wei captures Tongwan City, destroys main Xia army

title_zh: 高句丽长寿王迁都平壤
title_en: King Jangsu of Goguryeo moves the capital to Pyongyang

title_zh: 刘宋元嘉之治进入鼎盛，政局安定
title_en: Yuanjia administration reaches its peak; political stability achieved

title_zh: 大夏末代皇帝赫连定在西秦被俘
title_en: Last Xia emperor Helian Ding captured by Western Qin

title_zh: 以弗所公会议召开，聂斯托利派被定为异端
title_en: Council of Ephesus is held; Nestorianism condemned as heresy

title_zh: 北魏太武帝第二次大举北伐柔然，勒石刻功
title_en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei launches second major campaign against Rouran, carves inscription

title_zh: 刘宋与北魏在淮水一带发生边境冲突
title_en: Border conflict between Liu Song and Northern Wei in the Huai River region

title_zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克率军征服北非全境
title_en: Vandal king Gaiseric conquers all of North Africa

title_zh: 爱尔兰修道士开始大规模手抄拉丁文经卷
title_en: Irish monks begin large-scale copying of Latin manuscripts

title_zh: 刘宋北伐军失败，尽失河南地
title_en: Liu Song northern expedition fails; all territory south of the Yellow River lost

title_zh: 希波主教奥古斯丁在汪达尔人围城期间去世
title_en: Augustine of Hippo dies during Vandal siege of Hippo Regius

title_zh: 匈人（匈奴）阿提拉和布莱达大举入侵东罗马帝国
title_en: Huns (Attila and Bleda) invade the Eastern Roman Empire on a large scale

title_zh: 北凉国王沮渠蒙逊讨伐西秦，夺取枹罕
title_en: Northern Liang king Juqu Mengxun attacks Western Qin, captures Fuhan

title_zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克攻陷希波城，焚烧教堂
title_en: Vandal king Gaiseric captures Hippo Regius, burns churches

title_zh: 匈奴国王阿提拉和布莱达再次入侵东罗马
title_en: Hun kings Attila and Bleda again invade the Eastern Roman Empire

title_zh: 刘宋益州爆发赵广起义，持续半年
title_en: Zhao Guang rebellion breaks out in Liu Song's Yizhou, lasting six months

title_zh: 圣帕特里克开始在爱尔兰传教
title_en: Saint Patrick begins missionary work in Ireland

title_zh: 西哥特王国在提奥多里克一世领导下继续扩张
title_en: Visigothic Kingdom under Theodoric I continues expansion

title_zh: 南朝宋诗人谢灵运被宋文帝处死
title_en: Liu Song poet Xie Lingyun executed by Emperor Wen of Song

title_zh: 东罗马帝国向匈奴支付巨额年贡，换取和平
title_en: Eastern Roman Empire pays huge annual tribute to the Huns in exchange for peace

title_zh: 匈奴国王布莱达去世，阿提拉独揽大权
title_en: Hun king Bleda dies; Attila takes sole power

title_zh: 刘宋与北魏在汝水、颍水一带持续冲突
title_en: Continued conflict between Liu Song and Northern Wei in the Ru and Ying river valleys

title_zh: 东罗马帝国修建多瑙河防线，应对匈奴威胁
title_en: Eastern Roman Empire builds Danube frontier defenses to counter Huns

title_zh: 北魏太武帝亲率大军征讨北燕，围困和龙
title_en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei leads campaign against Northern Yan, besieges Helong

title_zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克派舰队劫掠西西里和意大利南部
title_en: Vandal king Gaiseric sends fleet to plunder Sicily and southern Italy

title_zh: 东罗马帝国颁布《狄奥多西法典》
title_en: Eastern Roman Empire issues Theodosian Code

title_zh: 勃艮第人在高卢东南部建立勃艮第王国
title_en: Burgundians establish Burgundian Kingdom in southeastern Gaul

title_zh: 北魏攻破和龙，灭亡北燕
title_en: Northern Wei captures Helong, destroys Northern Yan

title_zh: 宋文帝设立四馆，大力发展学术
title_en: Emperor Wen of Song establishes Four Academies, greatly develops scholarship

title_zh: 东罗马击败匈奴的一次进攻，阿提拉受挫
title_en: Eastern Roman Empire repels a Hun attack; Attila is thwarted

title_zh: 东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世与雅典学者欧多克娅结婚
title_en: Eastern Roman Emperor Theodosius II marries Athenian scholar Eudocia

title_zh: 北凉国王沮渠蒙逊去世，北凉开始衰落
title_en: Northern Liang king Juqu Mengxun dies; Northern Liang begins to decline

title_zh: 《狄奥多西法典》：把皇帝敕令编成官方法典
title_en: The Theodosian Code turns imperial rulings into an official code

title_zh: 匈奴国王阿提拉进攻色萨利和希腊中部
title_en: Hun king Attila invades Thessaly and central Greece

title_zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克攻陷迦太基，建立汪达尔王国
title_en: Vandal king Gaiseric captures Carthage, establishes Vandal Kingdom

title_zh: 北魏太武帝率军西征，灭亡北凉，统一北方
title_en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei leads western expedition, destroys Northern Liang, unifies north

title_zh: 波斯伊嗣俟二世即位，加强对基督教徒的迫害
title_en: Yazdegerd II of Persia ascends throne, intensifies persecution of Christians

title_zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克占领西西里岛，控制地中海西部
title_en: Vandal king Gaiseric occupies Sicily, controls western Mediterranean

title_zh: 北凉残余势力在河西走廊发动起义
title_en: Northern Liang remnants launch revolt in Hexi Corridor

title_zh: 东罗马帝国与匈奴战争再起，巴尔干遭劫
title_en: War between Eastern Roman Empire and Huns resumes; Balkans ravaged

title_zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克与西哥特王国签订和约
title_en: Vandal king Gaiseric signs treaty with Visigothic Kingdom

title_zh: 北魏出兵消灭仇池国，控制陇南
title_en: Northern Wei dispatches troops to destroy Qiuci state, controlling Longnan

title_zh: 萨克森人开始大规模入侵不列颠东部海岸
title_en: Saxons begin large-scale invasions of eastern Britain

title_zh: 刘宋始兴王刘浚镇守京口，加强北边防务
title_en: Liu Song Prince Liu Jun stationed at Jingkou, strengthens northern defenses

title_zh: 东罗马与匈奴签订和约，年贡增至2100磅黄金
title_en: Eastern Roman Empire signs treaty with Huns; annual tribute increased to 2,100 pounds of gold

title_zh: 北魏太武帝再次北征柔然，柔然可汗吐贺真北遁
title_en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei again campaigns north against Rouran; Rouran khagan Tughuzhen flees north

title_zh: 匈奴王阿提拉征服巴尔干半岛内陆
title_en: Hun king Attila conquers the interior of the Balkan Peninsula

title_zh: 百济毗有王在位，与南朝交往频繁
title_en: Baekje's King Biyu maintains close contacts with the Southern Dynasties

title_zh: 刘宋朝廷商议再次北伐，因内部反对作罢
title_en: Liu Song court discusses another northern expedition but abandons it due to internal opposition

title_zh: 东罗马遣使波斯，尝试共同对抗匈奴
title_en: Eastern Roman Empire sends envoys to Persia, trying to ally against Huns

title_zh: 匈奴王阿提拉完全统一匈奴帝国，兄弟布莱达疑似被杀
title_en: Hun king Attila fully unifies the Hun Empire; brother Bleda supposedly killed

title_zh: 罗马教皇利奥一世与匈奴王阿提拉会面，劝说其放弃进攻罗马
title_en: Pope Leo I meets Attila, persuades him to abandon attack on Rome

title_zh: 卢水胡盖吴在杏城起义，联络刘宋
title_en: Lu Shui Hu chief Gai Wu revolts at Xingcheng, contacts Liu Song

title_zh: 刘宋与北魏在汝南、新蔡一带交战
title_en: Liu Song and Northern Wei clash in the Runan and Xincai region

title_zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克洗劫罗马城，带走大量财宝
title_en: Vandal king Gaiseric sacks Rome, carries away vast treasure

title_zh: 北魏太武帝下诏灭佛，焚毁佛经佛像
title_en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei issues edict to destroy Buddhism, burn scriptures and images

title_zh: 刘宋征讨林邑国，大获全胜
title_en: Liu Song attacks Linyi (Champa), achieves great victory

title_zh: 匈奴王阿提拉再次入侵东罗马，直逼君士坦丁堡
title_en: Hun king Attila again invades Eastern Roman Empire, advances to Constantinople

title_zh: 日本允恭天皇去世，安康天皇继位，爆发大伴氏之乱
title_en: Emperor Yuryaku of Japan ascends; strengthens centralization

title_zh: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘第六次北伐柔然，征服天山北部
title_en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei launches sixth campaign against Rouran, conquers northern Tianshan

title_zh: 东罗马遣使匈奴，试图与阿提拉和谈未果
title_en: Eastern Roman envoy sent to Huns; negotiations fail

title_zh: 东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世病逝，马尔西安继位
title_en: Eastern Roman Emperor Theodosius II dies; Marcian ascends

title_zh: 刘宋大举北伐——元嘉第二次北伐
title_en: Liu Song launches massive northern expedition — the second Yuanjia northern expedition

title_zh: 日本雄略天皇即位，强化中央集权
title_en: Emperor Yuryaku of Japan ascends, strengthens centralization

title_zh: 匈奴王阿提拉集结大军，准备西征高卢
title_en: Hun king Attila gathers massive army, prepares for western campaign against Gaul

title_zh: 刘宋元嘉北伐惨败，江北惨遭屠戮
title_en: Liu Song's Yuanjia northern expedition ends in disaster; Jiangbei region savagely ravaged

title_zh: 爱尔兰僧侣远航发现冰岛
title_en: Irish monks discover Iceland

title_zh: 北魏太武帝率军南征，到达瓜步，威胁建康
title_en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei leads southern campaign, reaches Guabu, threatens Jiankang

title_zh: 卡尔西顿公会议：二性论成为正统
title_en: Council of Chalcedon: two natures become orthodox

title_zh: 沙隆战役：罗马-西哥特联军击败匈奴王阿提拉
title_en: Battle of the Catalaunian Plains: Roman-Visigothic coalition defeats Attila

title_zh: 北魏太武帝被宦官宗爱杀害，文成帝继位
title_en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei murdered by eunuch Zong Ai; Emperor Wencheng ascends

title_zh: 刘宋太子刘劭与文帝矛盾激化，政局动荡
title_en: Liu Song crown prince Liu Shao conflicts with Emperor Wen; political turmoil

title_zh: 汪达尔国王盖萨里克去世，胡内里克继位
title_en: Vandal king Gaiseric dies; Huneric succeeds

title_zh: 匈奴王阿提拉突然去世，帝国迅速瓦解
title_en: Hun king Attila dies suddenly; empire quickly disintegrates

title_zh: 刘宋内乱：刘骏起兵讨伐刘劭
title_en: Liu Song civil war: Liu Jun raises troops to attack Liu Shao

title_zh: 东哥特人在潘诺尼亚起义，摆脱匈奴控制
title_en: Ostrogoths rise in Pannonia, throw off Hun control

title_zh: 匈奴王阿提拉诸子争位，帝国分裂
title_en: Attila's sons fight for succession; empire fragments

title_zh: 匈奴邓吉西克入侵东罗马，兵败被杀
title_en: Hun Dengizich invades Eastern Roman Empire; defeated and killed

title_zh: 刘骏攻破建康，诛杀刘劭，即皇帝位
title_en: Liu Jun captures Jiankang, executes Liu Shao, ascends throne

title_zh: 西罗马统帅埃提乌斯被皇帝瓦伦提尼安三世谋杀
title_en: Western Roman general Aetius murdered by Emperor Valentinian III

title_zh: 刘骏镇压竟陵王刘诞叛乱
title_en: Emperor Xiaowu of Song suppresses rebellion of Prince of Jingling, Liu Dan

title_zh: 西罗马皇帝瓦伦提尼安三世被杀，帝国名存实亡
title_en: Western Roman Emperor Valentinian III killed; empire in name only

title_zh: 汪达尔军队洗劫罗马城，带走皇室财宝
title_en: Vandal army sacks Rome, carries off imperial treasure

title_zh: 刘宋爆发宗室内讧，多王被杀
title_en: Intra-imperial clan strife in Liu Song; several princes killed

title_zh: 东罗马皇帝马尔西安去世，利奥一世继位
title_en: Eastern Roman Emperor Marcian dies; Leo I ascends

title_zh: 西哥特国王提奥多里克二世攻占西班牙大部分地区
title_en: Visigothic king Theodoric II conquers most of Spain

title_zh: 苏维汇国王雷基亚里乌斯被西哥特人击败并处死
title_en: Suebic king Rechiarius defeated and executed by Visigoths

title_zh: 东罗马皇帝利奥一世登基，建立利奥王朝
title_en: Eastern Roman Emperor Leo I crowned, establishes Leonid dynasty

title_zh: 宋孝武帝推行新政，削弱门阀势力
title_en: Emperor Xiaowu of Song implements new policies to weaken aristocratic clans

title_zh: 北魏文成帝下诏恢复佛教，云冈石窟开凿
title_en: Emperor Wencheng of Northern Wei restores Buddhism; excavation of Yungang Grottoes begins

title_zh: 东罗马皇帝利奥一世重建海军，对抗汪达尔人
title_en: Eastern Roman Emperor Leo I rebuilds navy to counter Vandals

title_zh: 刘宋将领沈庆之平定浙东农民起义
title_en: Liu Song general Shen Qingzhi suppresses peasant rebellion in eastern Zhejiang

title_zh: 东罗马远征汪达尔失败，海军覆灭
title_en: Eastern Roman expedition against Vandals fails catastrophically; navy destroyed

title_zh: 沈庆之再次平定竟陵王刘诞叛乱
title_en: Shen Qingzhi again suppresses rebellion of Prince of Jingling, Liu Dan

title_zh: 法兰克国王希尔德里克一世去世，克洛维一世继位
title_en: Frankish king Childeric I dies; Clovis I ascends

title_zh: 云冈石窟大规模开凿，成为中国北方佛教艺术中心
title_en: Large-scale excavation of Yungang Grottoes makes it a center of Buddhist art in northern China

title_zh: 嚈哒人（白匈奴）进攻萨珊波斯，波斯称臣纳贡
title_en: Hephthalites (White Huns) attack Sassanian Persia; Persia submits and pays tribute

title_zh: 琵琶经丝绸之路传入中国中原地区
title_en: Pipa enters central China via the Silk Road

title_zh: 西哥特国王提奥多里克二世征服苏维汇王国
title_en: Visigothic king Theodoric II conquers the Suebic Kingdom

title_zh: 高句丽长寿王在位，与北魏建立外交关系
title_en: Goguryeo King Jangsu establishes diplomatic relations with Northern Wei

title_zh: 刘宋爆发宗室诸王互相残杀的局面
